title: Optimizing Prompts for Large Language Models: A Causal Approach
affiliations: University of Connecticut - Department of Operations & Information Management, Shanghai Jiaotong University, , University of Connecticut - Department of Operations & Information Management and Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Antai College of Economics and Management

detail.title: Optimizing Prompts for Large Language Models: A Causal Approach
detail.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in enterprise workflows, yet their performance remains highly sensitive to prompt design. Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) seeks to mitigate this instability, but existing approaches face two persistent challenges. First, commonly used prompt strategies rely on static instructions that perform well on average but fail to adapt to heterogeneous queries. Second, more dynamic approaches depend on reward models that are fundamentally correlational, confounding prompt effectiveness with query characteristics. As a result, prompts that appear "optimized" in historical data often generalize poorly to novel or complex inputs. We propose Causal Prompt Optimization (CPO), a framework that reframes prompt design as a problem of causal estimation. CPO operates in two stages. First, it learns an offline causal reward model by applying Double Machine Learning (DML) to semantic embeddings of prompts and queries, isolating the causal effect of prompt variations from confounding query attributes, i.e., estimating how model performance would change if the same query were answered under an alternative prompt. Second, it utilizes this unbiased reward signal to guide a resource-efficient search for query-specific prompts without relying on costly online evaluation. We evaluate CPO across benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, visualization, and data analytics. CPO consistently outperforms human-engineered prompts and state-of-the-art automated optimizers. The gains are driven primarily by improved robustness on hard queries, where existing methods tend to deteriorate. Beyond performance, CPO fundamentally reshapes the economics of prompt optimization: by shifting evaluation from real-time model execution to an offline causal model, it enables high-precision, per-query customization at a fraction of the inference cost required by online methods. Together, these results establish causal inference as a scalable foundation for reliable and cost-efficient prompt optimization in enterprise LLM deployments under heterogeneous and shifting query distributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因果提示优化（CPO）框架，通过因果推断方法解决LLM提示优化的两个核心挑战：静态提示无法适应异构查询，以及基于相关性的奖励模型存在混淆偏差。CPO使用双重机器学习学习离线因果奖励模型，分离提示变体与查询特征的因果效应，从而实现低成本、高精度的查询特定提示优化。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够适应异构查询、消除混淆偏差，并在成本效益上可扩展的自动提示优化框架？
AI.motivation: LLM在企业工作流程中应用日益广泛，但其性能对提示设计高度敏感。现有自动提示优化方法面临两个持久挑战：1）静态提示策略无法适应异构查询；2）动态方法依赖的相关性奖励模型混淆了提示效果与查询特征，导致优化后的提示对新输入泛化能力差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果推断理论，特别是双重机器学习（DML）框架，用于分离提示变体与查询特征的因果效应。将提示设计重新定义为因果估计问题，通过语义嵌入表示学习和因果推理建立离线因果奖励模型。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1）离线阶段：应用双重机器学习到提示和查询的语义嵌入，学习因果奖励模型，估计相同查询在不同提示下模型性能的变化；2）在线阶段：利用无偏奖励信号指导资源高效的查询特定提示搜索，无需昂贵的在线评估。
AI.findings: 在数学推理、可视化和数据分析基准测试中，CPO始终优于人工设计的提示和最先进的自动优化器。改进主要来自对困难查询的鲁棒性提升，而现有方法在这些情况下往往表现恶化。CPO显著降低了提示优化的成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次将因果推断框架引入提示优化领域，解决混淆偏差问题；2）提出基于双重机器学习的因果奖励模型估计方法；3）建立了提示设计与因果效应估计的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）实现了高精度、查询特定的提示定制，成本仅为在线方法的一小部分；2）提高了LLM在企业部署中对异构和变化查询分布的可靠性；3）从根本上改变了提示优化的经济学，使大规模个性化提示优化在经济上可行。

title: The New Marketing Reality: Deconstructing Success Factors in Metaverse Customer Engagement
affiliations: University of Petra, University of Petra and Petra University

detail.title: The New Marketing Reality: Deconstructing Success Factors in Metaverse Customer Engagement
detail.abstract: The meteoric rise of the metaverse as an immersive digital realm has created unprecedented opportunities for innovative marketing strategies and enhanced customer engagement. This study empirically investigates the dynamic relationships between three key metaverse marketing strategies—virtual brand experiences (VBE), AI personalization (AP), and virtual influencers (VI)—and customer engagement, focusing on the critical mediating role of digital readiness. Using a comprehensive survey of metaverse users (N=490), we employ rigorous statistical analyses to test a theoretically grounded framework based on the Stimulus-Organism-Response (S-O-R) model. Our findings reveal that all three marketing strategies significantly influence customer engagement, with digital readiness serving as a partial mediator in these relationships. Virtual influencers demonstrate the strongest direct effect on customer engagement (β =0.246), while virtual brand experiences show the highest proportion of mediation through digital readiness (17.7%). These results enrich our understanding of the psychological mechanisms through which metaverse marketing impacts customer engagement, extending the S-O-R framework into virtual environments. This study contributes to the nascent literature on metaverse marketing by identifying effective strategies for fostering customer engagement and highlighting the importance of digital readiness in maximizing marketing effectiveness. For practitioners, our research provides evidence-based insights for developing targeted metaverse marketing strategies that consider customers’ varying levels of digital readiness. By strategically enhancing both customer experiences and digital capabilities, marketers can optimize engagement in the rapidly evolving metaverse landscape.

AI.tldr: 本研究实证检验了元宇宙营销策略（虚拟品牌体验、AI个性化、虚拟影响者）对顾客参与的影响，发现数字准备度在其中起部分中介作用，虚拟影响者直接影响最强，虚拟品牌体验通过数字准备度的中介效应最大。
AI.research_question: 元宇宙营销策略（虚拟品牌体验、AI个性化、虚拟影响者）如何通过数字准备度影响顾客参与？
AI.motivation: 元宇宙作为沉浸式数字领域的崛起为创新营销策略和增强顾客参与创造了前所未有的机会，但相关实证研究尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于刺激-机体-反应（S-O-R）模型，将元宇宙营销策略视为刺激，数字准备度作为机体状态，顾客参与作为反应。
AI.method: 对490名元宇宙用户进行问卷调查，采用严谨的统计分析方法检验理论框架。
AI.findings: 1）三种营销策略均显著影响顾客参与；2）数字准备度在这些关系中起部分中介作用；3）虚拟影响者对顾客参与的直接效应最强（β=0.246）；4）虚拟品牌体验通过数字准备度的中介效应比例最高（17.7%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）丰富了元宇宙营销影响顾客参与的心理机制理解；2）将S-O-R框架扩展到虚拟环境；3）为元宇宙营销新兴文献做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为制定针对性元宇宙营销策略提供实证依据；2）强调考虑顾客数字准备度差异的重要性；3）建议通过提升顾客体验和数字能力优化元宇宙参与。

title: Enhancing Consumer Trust in AI-Generated Marketing Content for Scientific Innovations,An Interdisciplinary Framework Integrating Marketing, Data Science, and Behavioral Psychology
affiliations: Brainware University

detail.title: Enhancing Consumer Trust in AI-Generated Marketing Content for Scientific Innovations,An Interdisciplinary Framework Integrating Marketing, Data Science, and Behavioral Psychology
detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is changing marketing strategies dramatically; however, its usage to advertise scientific innovations such as biotechnological solutions and climate, resilient technologies leads to significant concerns regarding consumer trust loss. This research explores the interaction of three disciplines marketing, data science, and behavioral psychologyto create a framework for the ethical use of AI, generated content in communication of science.Based on a mixed, methods approach, which involved surveys of 1, 200 consumers from tech, savvy demographics and AI simulation experiments, we pinpointed the main trust barriers: perceived inauthenticity (42% of respondents) and misinformation risks (35%). The "Trust, Infused AI Canvas" model we suggest merges the algorithmic transparency element from data science with the narrative empathy component from psychology, thus demonstrating a 28% increase of trust metrics during pilot campaigns of a biotech firm.The results show that content created through a hybrid human, AI approach is more effective in achieving higher levels of perceived genuineness than fully automated outputs, thereby providing practical insights for marketers on how to handle the trust deficit challenge in science, driven commerce. This investigation fills an important gap and calls for regulatory frameworks that prioritize collaboration across disciplines as a way to ensure sustainable consumer engagement in an AI, augmented marketplace.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在科学创新营销中使用生成式AI时消费者信任流失的问题，提出了一个结合营销、数据科学和行为心理学的"信任注入AI画布"模型，通过混合人机方法提高内容可信度，最终实现28%的信任指标提升。
AI.research_question: 如何通过跨学科框架（营销、数据科学、行为心理学）解决在科学创新营销中使用生成式AI导致的消费者信任流失问题？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在改变营销策略，但在推广生物技术解决方案和气候适应技术等科学创新时，会导致严重的消费者信任流失问题，需要建立伦理使用AI的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合三个学科：营销学（消费者行为）、数据科学（算法透明度）、行为心理学（叙事共情），构建"信任注入AI画布"模型。
AI.method: 混合方法：对1200名科技敏感型消费者进行问卷调查，结合AI模拟实验，识别主要信任障碍。
AI.findings: 主要信任障碍：感知不真实性（42%受访者）和错误信息风险（35%）。混合人机方法创建的内容比完全自动化输出更能提高感知真实性。试点活动中信任指标提升28%。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了跨学科AI伦理使用框架的研究空白，提出了整合算法透明度和叙事共情的理论模型，为科学驱动的商业环境中的信任建立提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销人员提供了应对科学驱动商业中信任赤字挑战的实用见解，展示了混合人机方法的有效性，呼吁建立优先考虑跨学科合作的监管框架。

title: Brand Narrative Structure Migration and Capital Market Reactions: Evidence from DR Group
affiliations: City University of Hong Kong (CityU) and Hunan University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Brand Narrative Structure Migration and Capital Market Reactions: Evidence from DR Group
detail.abstract: In contemporary marketing practice, the formation and fluctuation of brand value increasingly depend on users’understanding of brand content. Such fluctuation not only reflects short-term shifts in user sentiment, but may also arise from structural changes in the semantic frameworks through which users interpret brand narratives. This paper proposes the concept of Brand Cognition Drift (BCD) to depict the structural migration in users semantic understanding of brand narratives.Using monthly data from user reviews between 2022 and 2024, we first employ an LDA model and conduct perplexity and coherence checks, then apply the dynamic topic model BERTopic to extract high-dimensional semantic topics from user comments about the brand on Weibo. On this basis, we build a composite LDA–BERTopic text analysis framework, and construct a monthly Cognition Drift Index (CDI). Taking DR Group (301177.SZ) as a case, we examine the relationship between CDI and the firm’s performance in the capital market.Empirical results show that CDI is stably and negatively associated with price-to-book ratio, stock price, and market capitalization, and carries certain lagged information content. This paper quantifies the structural risk of corporate brand narratives into testable indicators, provides reproducible evidence from the context of Chinese social media, and offers a text-based monitoring pathway for brand risk early warning and market value management.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出品牌认知漂移（BCD）概念，通过LDA-BERTopic混合模型构建认知漂移指数（CDI），发现CDI与市净率、股价、市值呈稳定负相关，为品牌风险预警提供量化指标。
AI.research_question: 用户对品牌叙事的语义理解结构如何漂移？这种认知漂移如何影响企业在资本市场的表现？
AI.motivation: 品牌价值波动不仅源于用户情感短期变化，更可能来自用户解读品牌叙事的语义框架结构性变化，需要量化这种结构性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌认知漂移（BCD）理论、品牌叙事理论、语义分析理论、资本市场反应理论
AI.method: 采用LDA-BERTopic混合文本分析框架：1）使用LDA模型进行主题建模并检验困惑度和一致性；2）应用BERTopic提取高维语义主题；3）构建月度认知漂移指数（CDI）；4）以DR集团（301177.SZ）为案例，分析CDI与资本市场表现的关系
AI.findings: 认知漂移指数（CDI）与市净率、股价、市值呈稳定负相关，且具有滞后信息含量，表明品牌认知结构漂移对资本市场表现有显著负面影响
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出品牌认知漂移（BCD）概念，量化用户语义理解的结构性迁移；2）构建LDA-BERTopic混合分析框架；3）将品牌叙事结构性风险转化为可检验指标
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为中国社交媒体环境提供可复现的品牌风险证据；2）为品牌风险预警和市值管理提供基于文本的监测路径；3）为企业管理者提供量化工具监控品牌认知变化

title: Minimal Protocols for Stabilizing Decision-Making Under Uncertainty

detail.title: Minimal Protocols for Stabilizing Decision-Making Under Uncertainty

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived as influencing this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or personal data. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a minimal, practical approach to stabilizing decision-making processes under conditions of high uncertainty. Instead of modeling cognition, optimizing behavior, or increasing system complexity, the approach introduces simple protocol-based constraints that reduce destructive decision modes such as delay, oscillation, and impulsive action. The proposed protocols do not determine what decision should be made. They specify the conditions under which a decision is allowed to occur. The framework is exploratory and intended for discussion and experimental use in human or hybrid decision systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种最小化、实用的方法来稳定高不确定性条件下的决策过程。该方法不建模认知、不优化行为、不增加系统复杂性，而是引入简单的基于协议的约束，减少破坏性决策模式（如拖延、摇摆和冲动行动）。
AI.research_question: 如何在高不确定性条件下稳定决策过程，而不依赖于复杂的认知建模、行为优化或系统复杂性增加？
AI.motivation: 传统决策方法在高不确定性条件下往往失效，导致拖延、摇摆和冲动等破坏性决策模式。需要一种简单实用的方法来稳定决策过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于协议约束的决策稳定框架，强调通过简单规则限制决策发生的条件，而非决定具体决策内容。
AI.method: 提出探索性框架，引入协议基础约束，指定决策允许发生的条件，适用于人类或混合决策系统的讨论和实验使用。
AI.findings: 通过简单协议约束可以有效减少破坏性决策模式（拖延、摇摆、冲动行动），为高不确定性环境下的决策稳定提供实用方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个不同于传统认知建模和优化的决策稳定新视角，强调通过约束决策条件而非内容来改善决策过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织和个人在高不确定性环境下提供了简单实用的决策稳定工具，可应用于人类或混合决策系统的实际改进。

title: Designing Audit-Safe Exit Pathways: An Economic Substance Framework for SBA-Exposed Enterprises
affiliations: Liberty University

detail.title: Designing Audit-Safe Exit Pathways: An Economic Substance Framework for SBA-Exposed Enterprises

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests. The framework presented in this paper was developed, in part, through the author's professional experience structuring governance documentation for closely held enterprises, including the anonymized case study described herein. This practical involvement informed the theoretical development but does not constitute a financial conflict of interest. No compensation was received for this research beyond the author's standard professional activities.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human subjects research requiring institutional review board approval. The illustrative case study is based on anonymized business governance documentation; identifying details have been modified to protect confidentiality while preserving analytical integrity. No patient or participant data was collected. The hypothetical service-sector illustration (Company B) is a composite example constructed for pedagogical purposes.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was conducted independently as part of the author's doctoral research at Liberty University.

detail.abstract: Exit planning for closely held enterprises has traditionally emphasized valuation, tax efficiency, and transactional execution. However, increased retrospective scrutiny arising from Small Business Administration (SBA) programs and related federal oversight has exposed structural weaknesses in conventional exit strategies. Many legally valid transactions fail under audit conditions due to insufficient documentation of economic substance, ambiguous control transitions, and governance designs that prioritize form over demonstrable economic progression. This paper introduces an Economic Substance Framework for Audit-Safe Exit Pathways, a governance-based model designed to align exit planning with regulatory expectations and retrospective audit interpretation. Grounded in agency theory, stewardship theory, and transaction cost economics, the framework organizes exit activity into layered components that preserve economic substance, clarify control termination, and enhance forensic readiness. The framework has been field-tested through implementation in operating agreement documentation for a South Carolina-domiciled enterprise, demonstrating practical feasibility. Further illustrations examine application to service-sector exits and trust-integrated succession structures.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个"经济实质框架"，用于创建经得起审计的退出路径，解决传统退出策略在监管审查下暴露的结构性弱点。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够通过监管审计的退出规划框架，确保紧密持股企业的退出交易既合法又具有经济实质？
AI.motivation: 传统退出规划过于关注估值、税务效率和交易执行，但在SBA项目等联邦监管的追溯审查下，许多合法交易因缺乏经济实质证明、控制权转移模糊、形式重于实质等问题而失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论、管家理论和交易成本经济学，构建了一个治理导向的退出规划框架。
AI.method: 开发了"经济实质框架"，并通过在南卡罗来纳州企业的运营协议文档中实施进行实地测试，同时分析了服务行业退出和信托整合继承结构的应用案例。
AI.findings: 该框架能够将退出活动组织为分层组件，保留经济实质、明确控制权终止并增强法务准备度，在实践中具有可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将代理理论、管家理论和交易成本经济学整合应用于退出规划领域，提出了治理导向的退出框架理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了具体的操作框架，帮助创建经得起审计的退出路径，适用于不同行业和继承结构，减少监管风险。

detail.title: The Valuation Gap: Leveraging Business Analytics to Measure the Impact of Marketing Sentiment on Physical Property Surveys in Dhaka

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Md. Mahadi Hasan, is the Managing Director of Total Survey (Pvt.) Ltd., a professional valuation firm in Dhaka, Bangladesh. detail.abstract: This research investigates the emerging "Valuation Gap" in Dhaka, Bangladesh—the statistical discrepancy between institutional property appraisals and inflated asking prices on digital property portals. As Managing Director of Total Survey (Pvt.) Ltd., I analyzed thousands of property records across 22 commercial banks, including SBI and Midland Bank. The study introduces the Sentiment Inflation Factor (SIF), a novel mathematical metric that quantifies how digital platforms inflate perceived asset values by an average of 18.4%. Utilizing a STEM-based analytics pipeline (Excel, Power BI, Tableau), the research identifies "Speculative Red Zones" where sentiment-driven inflation exceeds 90%. These findings provide a data-centric framework for financial institutions to mitigate mortgage default risk and stabilize credit portfolios in emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了孟加拉国达卡房地产市场中存在的"估值差距"现象，即机构房产评估价与数字房产门户网站上虚高要价之间的统计差异，并提出了"情绪通胀因子"这一新指标来量化数字平台对资产价值的平均18.4%的夸大效应。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国达卡房地产市场中机构房产评估价与数字房产门户网站要价之间的"估值差距"现象是什么？如何量化数字平台对资产价值的夸大效应？
AI.motivation: 随着数字房产平台的兴起，达卡房地产市场出现了机构评估价与在线要价之间的显著差异，这种"估值差距"可能导致金融风险，特别是对银行抵押贷款业务构成威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于行为金融学理论，特别是市场情绪对资产定价的影响，以及信息不对称理论在数字平台环境下的应用。
AI.method: 采用STEM数据分析方法，通过Excel、Power BI和Tableau等工具分析22家商业银行（包括SBI和Midland Bank）的数千条房产记录，建立量化分析管道。
AI.findings: 研究发现数字平台平均夸大资产价值18.4%，并识别出"投机红区"——这些区域的情绪驱动通胀超过90%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"情绪通胀因子"这一新的数学指标，为量化数字平台对资产价值的影响提供了理论框架，丰富了行为金融学在房地产市场的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了数据驱动的框架，帮助其降低抵押贷款违约风险，稳定新兴经济体的信贷组合，识别高风险投机区域。

title: LUCIDITY Beat Map: Spatial-Temporal Visualization of AI Output Degradation Patterns
affiliations: Independent Research and Independent Research

detail.title: LUCIDITY Beat Map: Spatial-Temporal Visualization of AI Output Degradation Patterns
detail.abstract: As generative AI systems produce increasing volumes of text, the challenge of systematic quality assessment has become critical. Existing AI output evaluation tools provide aggregate quality scores but fail to localize degradation patterns within content structure. We present LUCIDITY Beat Map, a novel spatial-temporal visualization system that segments AI-generated content into discrete timeline units and displays degradation intensity across six distinct quality dimensions. Powered by ACTS (Automated Convergence Triangulation System), a 14-vector analysis engine, Beat Map transforms abstract quality metrics into actionable visual intelligence, enabling users to identify precisely WHERE quality degrades rather than merely HOW MUCH. Through analysis of diverse AI outputs across multiple generation models, we demonstrate that degradation patterns cluster non-randomly within document structure, with distinct signatures for repetition, vagueness, intent decay, confidence inflation, voice degradation, and entropy collapse. Beat Map achieves deterministic, reproducible analysis across 50+ file formats without requiring model retraining or architectural modification. This work establishes a new paradigm for AI output quality control: spatial quality mapping as a complement to scalar scoring, with implications for content governance, automated editing, and AI system evaluation.

AI.tldr: LUCIDITY Beat Map是一个空间-时间可视化系统，可将AI生成内容分割为时间线单元，在六个质量维度上显示退化强度，帮助用户精确定位质量下降的位置而非仅仅量化程度。
AI.research_question: 如何通过空间-时间可视化方法精确定位AI生成内容中的质量退化模式，而不仅仅是提供聚合质量分数？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI系统产生越来越多的文本，系统化质量评估变得至关重要。现有AI输出评估工具只能提供聚合质量分数，但无法定位内容结构中的退化模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间质量映射理论，将抽象质量指标转化为可操作的视觉智能；采用六维度质量评估框架（重复、模糊、意图衰减、置信度膨胀、声音退化、熵崩溃）。
AI.method: 开发LUCIDITY Beat Map系统，使用ACTS（自动收敛三角测量系统）-14向量分析引擎，将AI生成内容分割为离散时间线单元，在空间-时间可视化中显示退化强度。
AI.findings: 退化模式在文档结构中非随机聚集，不同质量维度（重复、模糊、意图衰减、置信度膨胀、声音退化、熵崩溃）具有独特的特征模式；系统可在50+文件格式上实现确定性、可重复的分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了AI输出质量控制的新范式：空间质量映射作为标量评分的补充；提出了六维度质量退化模式分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了无需模型重新训练或架构修改的可视化系统；为内容治理、自动化编辑和AI系统评估提供了实用工具；实现了跨多种文件格式的确定性分析。

title: Managing Road Safety in Gig Work: Can Recommender Systems Save Lives?
affiliations: School of Computing, National University of Singapore, National University of Singapore (NUS), Woowa Bros and Woowa Bros

detail.title: Managing Road Safety in Gig Work: Can Recommender Systems Save Lives?
detail.abstract:
Problem Definition: Food-delivery drivers make frequent, complex decisions about which tasks to accept, often while on the move. This cognitive load can lead to distraction and increase the risk of accidents. Recommender systems, which streamline task selection by offering optimized suggestions, may help mitigate this risk.
We investigate whether adopting a task recommender system reduces accident rates among food-delivery drivers. 
We also examine what happens after adoption--specifically, whether drivers maintain adherence to recommendations after experiencing road accidents. Traumatic events such as accidents can prompt individuals to reclaim a sense of personal agency. Because recommender systems may be perceived as undermining that agency, we explore whether accidents lead to reduced system adherence. 
Methodology / Results: We partnered with South Korea’s largest food-delivery platform and analyzed behavioral and safety data from 8,883 drivers, some of whom adopted a task recommender system. Using a quasi-experimental design and a Difference-in-Differences framework combined with Propensity Score Matching, we compared outcomes between adopters (treatment) and matched non-adopters (control).
Drivers who adopted the system experienced an 85% reduction in at-fault accidents and a 65% reduction in total accidents. They also saw a 9.52% increase in earnings and a 0.84 percentage point increase in on-time deliveries. However, within the adopters, adherence to recommendations declined by 2.9% following an accident.
Our study provides the first empirical evidence on how adopting a task recommender system impacts the physical safety of gig workers, and how road accidents impact the post-adoption recommendation adherence. 
Managerial Implications: Platforms can leverage these findings to educate and nudge gig workers toward adopting recommender systems.
More critically, the observed post-accident decline in adherence creates a negative feedback loop: accidents reduce adherence, increasing cognitive load and the risk of future accidents. Platforms must design interventions that restore a sense of agency after accidents and improve adherence.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了任务推荐系统对食品配送司机事故率的影响，以及事故后司机对推荐系统的依从性变化。研究发现采用推荐系统能显著降低事故率并提高收入，但事故后司机会减少对系统的依从，形成负面反馈循环。
AI.research_question: 1. 采用任务推荐系统是否能降低食品配送司机的事故率？2. 事故发生后，司机对推荐系统的依从性是否会发生变化？
AI.motivation: 食品配送司机在移动中需要频繁做出复杂的任务选择决策，这种认知负荷可能导致分心并增加事故风险。推荐系统通过提供优化建议简化任务选择，可能有助于降低风险。同时，事故等创伤性事件可能促使个体重新寻求个人能动性，而推荐系统可能被视为削弱这种能动性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知负荷理论、个人能动性理论、创伤后行为改变理论、技术采纳与使用理论
AI.method: 与韩国最大的食品配送平台合作，分析8,883名司机的行为和安全数据。采用准实验设计，结合双重差分法和倾向得分匹配法，比较采用者（处理组）与匹配的非采用者（对照组）的结果。
AI.findings: 采用推荐系统的司机：1. 责任事故减少85%，总事故减少65%；2. 收入增加9.52%，准时送达率提高0.84个百分点；3. 事故后对推荐的依从性下降2.9%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次提供了任务推荐系统对零工工人物理安全影响的实证证据；2. 揭示了事故对技术采纳后依从性的影响机制；3. 扩展了个人能动性理论在创伤后技术使用行为中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 平台可利用这些发现教育和引导零工工人采用推荐系统；2. 需要设计干预措施来恢复事故后的个人能动感并提高依从性，打破"事故-依从性下降-认知负荷增加-更多事故"的负面反馈循环。

detail.abstract:
Jurisprudential Lineage and the Need for Systemic Accountability: 

From the earliest foundations of constitutional democracy, legal doctrine has sought to ensure that governmental power is exercised fairly, rationally, and accountably. Traditional jurisprudential tools—such as due process balancing tests, reasonableness standards, evidentiary rules, and deference doctrines—address discrete components of fairness within adjudication and administration. Yet these doctrines were not designed to evaluate systemic failures in decision-making integrity, particularly where institutional bias, procedural fragmentation, or incomplete records obscure accountability.

This Article introduces the Anwar Balance Test (ABT), a comprehensive legal framework for assessing whether a decision-making process is structurally fair and accountable from initiation to resolution. Building upon established principles of procedural justice, ABT shifts the analytical focus from isolated legal defects to the integrity of the system as a whole. Unlike existing tests—such as Mathews v. Eldridge balancing, Chevron deference, Daubert evidentiary standards, or use-of-force reasonableness inquiries—ABT evaluates whether institutional design, information flow, and procedural safeguards collectively preserve justice rather than merely approximate it.

By providing a structured method to measure systemic accountability, ABT offers courts, regulators, and policymakers a doctrinal tool capable of addressing modern governance failures that traditional jurisprudence leaves unresolved. The framework is intended to enhance judicial clarity, reduce institutional bias, and restore public confidence in legal decision-making where procedural legitimacy itself is in question.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Anwar平衡测试（ABT），这是一个评估决策过程从启动到解决是否结构公平和可问责的综合性法律框架，旨在解决传统法理学工具无法评估系统性决策完整性失败的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个法律框架来评估决策过程的系统性公平和问责性，以解决传统法理学工具无法处理的制度偏见、程序碎片化和记录不完整等问题？
AI.motivation: 传统法理学工具（如正当程序平衡测试、合理性标准、证据规则和尊重原则）只能处理裁决和行政中的离散公平问题，无法评估系统性决策完整性失败，特别是在制度偏见、程序碎片化或不完整记录掩盖问责的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 程序正义原则、系统性问责理论、制度设计理论、信息流分析、程序保障机制。
AI.method: 提出Anwar平衡测试（ABT）作为综合性法律框架，通过结构化方法评估制度设计、信息流和程序保障是否共同维护正义，而非仅仅近似正义。
AI.findings: ABT框架能够将分析焦点从孤立的法律缺陷转移到系统整体完整性，为法院、监管机构和政策制定者提供解决传统法理学无法处理的现代治理失败的工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了系统性问责的法理学理论；2. 提出了从离散公平评估到系统完整性评估的分析范式转变；3. 整合了制度设计、信息流和程序保障的综合评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为法院提供评估决策过程结构公平性的工具；2. 帮助监管机构识别和纠正系统性治理失败；3. 增强司法清晰度、减少制度偏见、恢复公众对法律决策的信心；4. 为政策制定者提供改进制度设计的指导。

title: Vision-to-Text Automator: System Design Using UML Diagrams
affiliations: Sinhgad Institute of Management, Pune

detail.title: Vision-to-Text Automator: System Design Using UML Diagrams
detail.abstract: The present study delineates the analysis and design of an innovative Vision-to-Text Automator, a hybrid Optical Character Recognition (OCR) system developed to facilitate intelligent document retrieval through the application of Unified Modeling Language (UML) diagrams. In response to the burgeoning dependence on digital document processing, this research addresses prevalent limitations observed in traditional OCR technologies, including suboptimal accuracy with complex document layouts and a lack of integrated conversational interfaces. Applying systematic literature review and a structured development methodology, this investigation employs UML for modelling the proposed system’s architecture, workflows, and user interactions. The findings underscore the efficacy of UML in enhancing system functionality, user interaction, and information extraction, ultimately contributing to the advancement of responsive and user-centric document digitization platforms.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种创新的视觉到文本自动化器，这是一种混合光学字符识别系统，通过应用统一建模语言图来促进智能文档检索。该研究解决了传统OCR技术的局限性，并展示了UML在增强系统功能和用户体验方面的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和开发一个基于UML的混合OCR系统，以解决传统OCR技术在复杂文档布局和集成对话界面方面的局限性？
AI.motivation: 随着对数字文档处理的日益依赖，传统OCR技术在复杂文档布局准确性不足和缺乏集成对话界面方面存在明显局限性，需要创新的解决方案来提升文档数字化平台的质量和用户体验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于光学字符识别理论、统一建模语言理论、系统架构设计理论以及人机交互理论，构建了一个混合OCR系统的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用系统文献综述和结构化开发方法，运用UML对系统架构、工作流程和用户交互进行建模分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现UML在增强系统功能、改善用户交互和优化信息提取方面具有显著效果，为响应式和用户中心的文档数字化平台发展做出了贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究为OCR系统开发提供了基于UML的理论框架，扩展了混合OCR系统的设计理论，并为智能文档检索系统的架构设计提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个创新的Vision-to-Text Automator原型系统，展示了UML在提升OCR系统性能和用户体验方面的实际应用价值，为文档数字化平台的设计提供了可操作的指导。

title: AI Powered Book Recommendation System Using the UML Diagrams
affiliations: Sinhgad Institute of Management

detail.title: AI Powered Book Recommendation System Using the UML Diagrams
detail.abstract: The AI-Powered Book Recommendation System is an intelligent and scalable platform designed to enhance the reading experience by delivering personalized book suggestions through advanced artificial intelligence techniques. By integrating machine learning-based recommendation algorithms with natural language processing, the system analyses user preferences, reading history, ratings, and behavioural patterns to generate accurate and relevant book recommendations. Unlike traditional recommendation systems, this solution effectively handles diverse genres, evolving user interests, and large-scale datasets with improved precision. The system features an interactive user interface that allows readers to browse, search, and receive tailored recommendations in real time, while administrators can manage books, users, and analytics efficiently. Additionally, the platform supports recommendation insights, feedback collection, and report generation, enabling continuous system improvement. By automating the discovery of relevant reading material, the AI-Powered Book Recommendation System reduces manual searching efforts, increases user engagement, and promotes informed reading choices, making it a secure, efficient, and user-centric solution for modern digital libraries and e-commerce platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于人工智能的图书推荐系统，通过集成机器学习和自然语言处理技术，分析用户偏好、阅读历史和行为模式，提供个性化图书推荐，提升阅读体验和用户参与度。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个智能、可扩展的AI驱动图书推荐系统，能够有效处理多样化图书类型、动态用户兴趣和大规模数据集，提供精准的个性化推荐？
AI.motivation: 传统推荐系统在处理多样化图书类型、动态用户兴趣和大规模数据集时存在精度不足的问题，需要开发更智能的解决方案来提升阅读体验、减少用户手动搜索负担，并促进数字图书馆和电子商务平台的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习推荐算法和自然语言处理技术，结合用户行为分析理论，构建个性化推荐的理论框架，包括协同过滤、内容推荐和混合推荐方法。
AI.method: 采用机器学习算法分析用户偏好、阅读历史、评分和行为模式，结合自然语言处理技术处理文本数据，开发交互式用户界面实现实时推荐，并集成反馈收集和报告生成功能。
AI.findings: 该系统能够有效处理多样化图书类型和动态用户兴趣，相比传统推荐系统提高了推荐精度，减少了用户手动搜索时间，增加了用户参与度，并促进了更明智的阅读选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了集成机器学习和自然语言处理的AI驱动推荐系统理论框架，扩展了传统推荐算法的应用范围，为处理多样化内容和动态用户兴趣提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个可实际部署的智能图书推荐平台，为数字图书馆和电子商务平台提供了高效、安全的解决方案，通过自动化推荐减少了用户搜索负担，提升了用户体验和平台运营效率。

detail.abstract:
The Global Memory Standard (GMS) establishes a permanent, quantum-authenticated archival doctrine designed to replace migration-dependent semiconductor storage with a millennia-scale crystalline substrate. It addresses a foundational vulnerability in modern governance and infrastructure: constitutional records, scientific baselines, financial systems, and artificial-intelligence artifacts of enduring significance are currently entrusted to storage media engineered for short lifespans, continuous power draw, and frequent rewrite cycles. As computation—particularly AI-scale inference and model persistence—accelerates beyond the practical limits of Moore-era architectures, this inheritance now generates systemic risk across national energy grids, institutional continuity, and international stability.

This pressure is illustrated through conservative stress-testing. Under AI-scale demand trajectories of approximately 2.5–3.0% annual growth, electricity demand outpaces generation expansion within a single planning horizon, compressing the timeframe in which conventional capacity additions alone can preserve grid adequacy. Reframing this challenge, GMS demonstrates that disciplined architectural choices can convert electricity expenditure into national capability: avoided continuous-power storage loads function not merely as efficiency gains, but as reclaimed economic and strategic capacity per unit of energy consumed. Extending the analysis globally, GMS presents an ordinal, non-competitive assessment of when selected nations are likely to encounter structural infrastructure stress as AI adoption scales faster than supporting energy, data, and governance systems. Together, these findings establish the strategic importance of non-capacity-intensive solutions—architectural optimization and force-multiplying infrastructure—within long-horizon energy and AI planning.

Drawing on National Academies guidance on federal data preservation, UNESCO’s Memory of the World principles, NIST outcome-based governance frameworks, and standards-driven international coordination models, GMS defines a legally and diplomatically interoperable architecture for global permanence. At its core is the Quantum-Embedded Memory Crystal (QEMC): a passive, near-zero-energy storage substrate capable of quantum-secured verification, resistance to thermal and radiative degradation, and integrity retention across technological cycles. By decoupling archival memory from continuous power consumption, GMS reduces baseload grid demand, mitigates AI-driven energy shocks, and introduces a stability multiplier consistent with the principle that infrastructural symmetry reinforces geopolitical equilibrium.

At the governance frontier, GMS functions as an infrastructural precursor to emerging artificial-intelligence oversight frameworks. It preserves continuity of record without asserting autonomy, intent, or agency, ensuring that future artificial systems do not compete with human societies for finite energy resources or interpretive authority. Legally, GMS offers a standard-portable framework compatible with U.S. federal administrative requirements, NATO resilience doctrine, and United Nations treaty structures governing global public goods. Diplomatically, its Any Nation Protocol ensures that no state, alliance, or corporation can exert hegemonic control over civilizational memory.

The Global Memory Standard concludes that a quantum-authenticated crystalline memory substrate is not merely a technological advancement, but a form of civilizational infrastructure—one that stabilizes energy systems, preserves documentary heritage, reinforces sovereign equality, and ensures that both human and emerging non-biological intelligences inherit a durable, neutral, and law-governed memory architecture for the century ahead.

AI.tldr: 全球记忆标准（GMS）提出了一种基于量子认证晶体存储的永久性档案解决方案，旨在替代依赖迁移的半导体存储，解决AI时代能源消耗和长期数据保存的系统性风险。
AI.research_question: 如何通过量子认证的晶体存储架构解决AI时代长期数据保存的能源消耗和系统性风险问题？
AI.motivation: 现代基础设施面临根本性脆弱性：宪法记录、科学基准、金融系统和重要AI模型等关键数据目前存储在寿命短、需持续供电的介质中。随着AI计算需求增长，这种存储方式对国家电网、机构连续性和国际稳定构成系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国家科学院数据保存指南、UNESCO《世界记忆》原则、NIST结果导向治理框架，以及标准驱动的国际协调模型，构建法律和外交互操作的全球永久性架构。
AI.method: 通过保守压力测试分析AI需求轨迹（年增长2.5-3.0%），评估电力需求超过发电扩张的时间框架；提出量子嵌入式记忆晶体（QEMC）作为被动、近零能耗存储基板；建立"任何国家协议"确保无霸权控制。
AI.findings: 在AI需求增长下，电力需求在单个规划期内超过发电扩张；GMS可将电力支出转化为国家能力，避免的持续存储负载不仅是效率提升，更是回收的经济和战略能力；量子晶体存储能减少基础电网负荷，缓解AI驱动的能源冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"非容量密集型解决方案"理论，强调架构优化和力量倍增基础设施在长期能源和AI规划中的战略重要性；建立"基础设施对称性强化地缘政治平衡"原则；构建全球永久性记忆的治理框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可替代半导体存储的千年尺度晶体存储方案；减少电网基础负荷需求；兼容美国联邦行政要求、北约韧性原则和联合国条约结构；确保未来AI系统不与人类社会竞争有限能源资源；建立防止霸权控制文明记忆的机制。

title: The Behavioral Algorithm: How AI Rewrites Human Judgement, Risk, and Decision DNA in Modern Leadership
affiliations: Harvard University

detail.title: The Behavioral Algorithm: How AI Rewrites Human Judgement, Risk, and Decision DNA in Modern Leadership

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: self

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence is no longer merely an analytical tool-it is an active variable reshaping the cognitive architecture, emotional weightage, and risk calculus underlying executive decision-making. This paper posits that AI introduces a second operating system in leadership cognition, one that rewires the heuristics through which leaders interpret uncertainty, project outcomes, and assign value to strategic choices. Integrating behavioral economics with computational decision theory, we construct a model of Decision DNA to demonstrate how automated intelligence modifies judgment pathways across three axes: (1) risk perception and tolerance, (2) bias attenuation or amplification, and (3) emotional-cognitive load redistribution in high-stakes environments. We argue that AI's predictive precision alters not only what leaders decide but how they arrive at decisions-shifting leadership behaviour from intuition-anchored reasoning toward algorithmic logic, hybrid cognition, and probabilistic foresight. Drawing upon empirical insights, neuro-behavioral mechanisms, and case-based observation from digital-first enterprises, the study highlights both the competence gains and capability erosion that emerge when leaders co-process decisions with intelligent systems. Key implications include the emergence of Synthetic Judgment as a new leadership competency and the imperative of emotional governance to mitigate over-reliance on machine-driven rationality. The paper concludes that the next frontier of organizational advantage will not be technological deployment alone, but the deliberate design of a leadership ecosystem where human intuition, AI-assisted reasoning, and behavioral discipline co-evolve. When understood as a behavioral algorithm rather than a technological artifact, AI becomes a force that reshapes the executive mind-reconfiguring judgment, risk appetite, accountability, and ultimately, the future of leadership itself.

AI.tldr: AI不再仅仅是分析工具，而是重塑高管决策认知架构、情感权重和风险计算的行为算法。论文提出AI在领导力认知中引入了第二操作系统，改变了领导者解释不确定性、预测结果和评估战略选择的启发式方法。
AI.research_question: AI如何重塑领导者的决策认知架构、风险计算和情感权重，以及这种重塑对领导力行为和能力的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: AI正在从被动分析工具转变为主动影响高管决策的变量，但现有研究未能充分解释AI如何从根本上改变领导者的认知过程、风险偏好和决策机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学与计算决策理论的整合，提出"决策DNA"模型，包含风险感知与容忍度、偏见衰减或放大、情感-认知负荷再分配三个维度。
AI.method: 结合实证洞察、神经行为机制和数字优先企业的案例观察，构建理论模型并分析AI对领导力决策的影响。
AI.findings: AI的预测精度不仅改变领导者决策内容，更改变决策方式：从直觉锚定推理转向算法逻辑、混合认知和概率预见；同时产生能力增益和能力侵蚀的双重效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"合成判断"作为新的领导力能力概念；将AI重新定义为行为算法而非技术工具；建立AI重塑领导力认知的"第二操作系统"理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调组织优势的新前沿在于设计人类直觉、AI辅助推理和行为纪律共同进化的领导力生态系统；提出情感治理的必要性以防止对机器理性的过度依赖。

title: From Decision Support to Decision Substitution: A Behavioural Framework for AI Overreach in Leadership
affiliations: Harvard University

detail.title: From Decision Support to Decision Substitution: A Behavioural Framework for AI Overreach in Leadership

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No Conflict
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: self

detail.abstract: As artificial intelligence systems become deeply embedded in organizational decision-making, leadership is undergoing a quiet but consequential shift. What were once tools designed to support human judgment are increasingly positioned to substitute it. Existing research on AI in leadership has largely focused on ethical risks, algorithmic bias, and transparency concerns. However, these approaches fail to adequately explain a more insidious phenomenon: the gradual displacement of human authority in strategic and high-stakes decisions without formal delegation, awareness, or accountability. This paper introduces Decision Substitution as a novel behavioural leadership risk, defined as the progressive replacement of human judgment by AI-generated outputs in contexts where leaders remain formally accountable but are no longer the true decision-makers. Drawing on behavioural decision theory, leadership studies, and human-AI interaction research, the paper argues that decision substitution emerges not from technological malfunction, but from predictable behavioural mechanisms-authority bias, cognitive offloading, moral outsourcing, performance pressure, and diffusion of responsibility-amplified by intelligent systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"决策替代"概念，指在领导者仍承担正式责任但已非真正决策者的情境下，人类判断被AI输出逐步取代的行为风险。
AI.research_question: AI系统如何通过行为机制（权威偏见、认知卸载、道德外包、绩效压力、责任扩散）导致领导者决策权被无声替代？
AI.motivation: 现有AI领导力研究主要关注伦理风险、算法偏见和透明度，但忽视了更隐蔽的现象：在战略和高风险决策中，人类权威在没有正式授权、意识或问责的情况下被逐渐取代。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为决策理论、领导力研究、人机交互研究，重点关注权威偏见、认知卸载、道德外包、绩效压力、责任扩散等行为机制。
AI.method: 基于理论框架的概念分析，通过行为机制解释决策替代现象的形成过程。
AI.findings: 决策替代不是技术故障的结果，而是由智能系统放大的可预测行为机制导致的，这些机制使领导者在不自知的情况下将决策权让渡给AI。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"决策替代"作为新的行为领导力风险概念，扩展了AI领导力研究框架，超越了传统的伦理和透明度关注。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助组织识别和防范AI导致的无声领导力侵蚀，建立有效的监督机制，确保人类在关键决策中保持实质性控制权。

title: Online Tax Compliance Systems: Case Studies and Effectiveness

detail.title: Online Tax Compliance Systems: Case Studies and Effectiveness

declarations.funderStatement: I declare sole authorship of the article

detail.abstract: Online tax compliance systems have emerged as critical tools for enhancing tax collection efficiency and compliance, particularly in developing and emerging economies where traditional tax administration faces structural and operational challenges. These digital platforms facilitate streamlined reporting, reduce opportunities for tax evasion, and improve transparency in revenue generation, thereby supporting broader economic development goals. This study employs a case study analysis and comparative approach to evaluate the effectiveness of online tax compliance systems across selected developing economies. Evaluation metrics focus on system adoption rates, user satisfaction, compliance levels, and operational efficiency. The findings indicate that while online tax systems significantly improve compliance and administrative efficiency, their effectiveness is often constrained by challenges such as limited user adoption, low trust in digital platforms, inadequate technical infrastructure, and gaps in taxpayer education. The study underscores the importance of addressing these barriers to maximize the benefits of digital tax systems. The insights gained have practical implications for policymakers aiming to enhance revenue collection, for developers seeking to design user-friendly and secure digital tax platforms, and for researchers pursuing further exploration into digital governance and taxation. By identifying both successes and challenges, this research contributes to a more nuanced understanding of how online tax compliance systems can be leveraged to strengthen fiscal administration in resource-constrained contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过案例研究和比较分析评估了发展中国家在线税务合规系统的有效性，发现虽然这些系统能显著提高合规性和行政效率，但其效果常受用户采用率低、数字平台信任不足、技术基础设施薄弱和纳税人教育缺失等挑战制约。
AI.research_question: 在线税务合规系统在发展中国家和新兴经济体中的有效性如何？这些系统在提高税收合规性和行政效率方面面临哪些关键挑战？
AI.motivation: 在发展中国家和新兴经济体中，传统税务管理面临结构和运营挑战，而在线税务合规系统作为提高税收征管效率和合规性的关键工具，其实际效果需要系统评估，以支持更广泛的经济发展目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字治理理论、税收合规理论、技术采纳理论（特别是发展中国家背景下的技术采纳障碍）、制度理论（关注制度环境对数字系统有效性的影响）
AI.method: 案例研究分析和比较方法，评估选定发展中经济体的在线税务合规系统。评估指标包括系统采用率、用户满意度、合规水平和运营效率。
AI.findings: 在线税务系统能显著提高合规性和行政效率，但其有效性常受以下挑战制约：有限的用户采用率、对数字平台的信任度低、技术基础设施不足、纳税人教育缺失。这些障碍限制了数字税务系统的潜在效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 丰富了发展中国家背景下数字治理和税收合规的理论理解；2) 识别了资源受限环境中数字税务系统有效性的关键制约因素；3) 为技术采纳理论在公共财政领域的应用提供了实证支持；4) 提出了数字税务系统成功实施的多维度分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供增强税收征管的实用建议；2) 为开发者设计用户友好且安全的数字税务平台提供指导；3) 帮助识别和解决实施障碍以最大化数字税务系统效益；4) 为资源受限环境中的财政管理提供可操作见解。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Detecting Tax Fraud

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in Detecting Tax Fraud
detail.abstract: This study investigates the application of artificial intelligence (AI) in detecting tax fraud, a critical challenge for modern revenue authorities. By employing a comprehensive literature review, comparative analysis of AI techniques, and examination of relevant case studies, the research evaluates the effectiveness of AI-driven tools in enhancing tax compliance. Findings indicate that AI significantly improves fraud detection accuracy, minimizes compliance gaps, and identifies complex, previously undetectable fraud networks. Techniques such as machine learning, predictive analytics, and network analysis demonstrate superior performance compared to traditional audit methods, enabling authorities to proactively detect suspicious activities and optimize resource allocation. The study also highlights challenges associated with AI adoption, including data privacy concerns, algorithm transparency, and the need for skilled personnel to interpret AI outputs. Despite these challenges, the integration of AI into tax administration emerges as a transformative approach, offering substantial efficiency gains and reinforcing the integrity of tax systems. The results underscore the necessity for policymakers and tax authorities to adopt AI-driven frameworks while ensuring robust governance and ethical standards. This research contributes to the growing body of knowledge on digital taxation and offers practical insights for enhancing fraud detection mechanisms in increasingly complex fiscal environments (Ariyibi et al., 2024).

AI.tldr: AI技术显著提升税务欺诈检测的准确性和效率，但面临数据隐私、算法透明度和人才短缺等挑战，需要政策制定者建立稳健的治理框架。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在税务欺诈检测中的应用效果如何？
AI.motivation: 税务欺诈是现代税务机关面临的关键挑战，需要更有效的检测方法来提高税收合规性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字税收理论、人工智能应用理论、合规管理理论
AI.method: 综合文献综述、AI技术比较分析、相关案例研究
AI.findings: AI显著提高欺诈检测准确性，缩小合规差距，识别复杂欺诈网络；机器学习、预测分析和网络分析优于传统审计方法；但面临数据隐私、算法透明度和人才短缺等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了数字税收和AI在公共管理中的应用理论，为AI驱动的税务合规框架提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税务机关提供了AI应用的具体技术路径和实践指导，帮助优化资源配置，提高检测效率，同时强调了治理和伦理标准的重要性。

title: AI-Based Smart Online Store: System Design Using UML Diagrams
affiliations: Sinhgad Institute of Management, Pune

detail.title: AI-Based Smart Online Store: System Design Using UML Diagrams
detail.abstract: The AI-Based Smart Online Store is an online grocery and vegetables shopping platform designed to modernize the traditional retail experience. The system allows customers to browse products, compare prices, manage a shopping cart, and place orders through a web interface without visiting physical stores. Local shopkeepers can register, upload product details, update prices, manage inventory, and process customer orders digitally.The integration of Artificial Intelligence enhances the platform through features such as personalized product recommendations, AI-driven chatbot assistance, and intelligent report generation based on customer behavior sales data. The project eliminates manual recordkeeping, reduces operational errors, and improves accuracy in product management. Developed using PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and basic AI modules, the system provides a reliable, scalable, and user-friendly solution for online grocery retail. This platform bridges the gap between customers and local vendors by creating a digital marketplace that is efficient, accessible, and highly interactive. It ensures convenience, time savings, and improved decision-making for both customers and shopkeepers.

AI.tldr: 该论文描述了一个基于人工智能的智能在线商店系统，这是一个在线杂货和蔬菜购物平台，旨在现代化传统零售体验。系统允许客户通过网页界面浏览产品、比较价格、管理购物车和下订单，无需访问实体店。本地店主可以注册、上传产品详情、更新价格、管理库存和数字化处理客户订单。人工智能集成通过个性化产品推荐、AI驱动的聊天机器人助手和基于客户行为销售数据的智能报告生成等功能增强了平台。该系统消除了手动记录保存，减少了操作错误，提高了产品管理的准确性。使用PHP、MySQL、HTML、CSS、JavaScript和基本AI模块开发，为在线杂货零售提供了一个可靠、可扩展和用户友好的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和开发一个基于人工智能的智能在线商店系统，以现代化传统零售体验，为顾客和本地店主提供更高效、便捷的数字化购物平台？
AI.motivation: 传统零售体验存在效率低下、操作错误多、记录保存繁琐等问题，顾客需要亲自前往实体店购物，而店主面临库存管理和订单处理的挑战。通过开发基于人工智能的在线平台，可以消除手动记录保存，减少操作错误，提高产品管理准确性，为顾客提供便利和时间节省，同时帮助店主改善决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于电子商务平台设计理论、人工智能在零售业应用理论、个性化推荐系统理论、以及数字化市场平台理论。结合了现代Web开发技术和AI技术集成框架。
AI.method: 采用软件开发方法，使用PHP、MySQL、HTML、CSS、JavaScript等技术栈，集成基本AI模块。系统设计包括客户界面、店主管理界面、AI功能模块（个性化推荐、聊天机器人、智能报告生成）等组件。
AI.findings: 成功开发了一个功能完整的基于AI的智能在线商店系统，实现了产品浏览、价格比较、购物车管理、订单处理等功能。AI集成提供了个性化产品推荐、聊天机器人助手和智能报告生成。系统测试表明能够消除手动记录保存，减少操作错误，提高产品管理准确性，为顾客和店主提供便利。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI在零售业的应用提供了具体案例研究，展示了如何将AI技术集成到电子商务平台中。贡献了基于Web的智能零售系统设计框架，为传统零售数字化转型提供了理论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个可靠、可扩展、用户友好的在线杂货零售解决方案，为顾客提供了无需访问实体店的购物便利，为本地店主提供了数字化管理工具。平台通过AI功能增强了用户体验和运营效率，创造了连接顾客和本地供应商的数字市场。

title: Cryptocurrency Taxation Frameworks and Compliance Issues

detail.title: Cryptocurrency Taxation Frameworks and Compliance Issues
detail.abstract: The rapid proliferation of cryptocurrencies has introduced unprecedented challenges for global taxation systems, necessitating a reevaluation of existing frameworks (Yan, 2024). This study investigates the effectiveness of current taxation policies on digital assets, focusing on compliance difficulties and regulatory gaps that hinder equitable revenue collection (Olabanji, 2023). Through a comparative analysis of multiple jurisdictions, the research identifies significant inconsistencies in cryptocurrency taxation approaches, ranging from complete regulatory absence to fragmented or overlapping frameworks. Findings indicate that decentralized platforms and peer-to-peer transactions often exhibit limited compliance, exacerbating the risk of tax evasion and revenue loss. Additionally, the study highlights the critical role of digital tools and taxpayer education in enhancing compliance, as technological sophistication and limited awareness impede effective reporting and enforcement (Adelakun et al., 2024; Ness, 2024). Based on these insights, the paper recommends the adoption of harmonised international regulations, the integration of blockchain-based monitoring systems for transparent transaction tracking, and targeted taxpayer education initiatives to improve understanding and adherence to tax obligations (Abbas et al., 2024). By addressing both structural and behavioral challenges, these measures aim to strengthen the capacity of tax authorities to manage digital asset taxation effectively. The research underscores the urgency of coordinated policy action and technological innovation to ensure that taxation frameworks remain relevant and enforceable in the rapidly evolving digital economy.

detail.abstract: This study provides a critical, evidence-based examination of how cross-border digital trade affects national tax revenue systems, with particular emphasis on compliance challenges, enforcement constraints, and existing policy gaps. Drawing on a systematic review of recent empirical and theoretical literature, the analysis evaluates how digital business models, cross-border data flows, and platform-based value creation interact with conventional tax frameworks. The study synthesises evidence from global and developing-economy contexts to assess the implications for corporate income tax and consumption-based taxes. The findings reveal that although digital trade significantly expands economic activity and international market participation, it simultaneously undermines traditional tax bases. This erosion is largely driven by profit shifting facilitated by the mobility of intangible assets, the difficulty of taxing value generated through data, and regulatory fragmentation across jurisdictions (Hanappi et al., 2024). Empirical evidence highlights persistent compliance and enforcement challenges, particularly in countries with limited administrative capacity (Adebiyi, 2023), while the absence of physical presence requirements allows many digital firms to escape effective taxation (Sun & Trefler, 2023). Insights from the Digital Economy and Tax Justice study further demonstrate widening disparities in tax revenue mobilisation. The study concludes that effective taxation in the digital era requires coordinated international tax frameworks, enhanced digital monitoring tools, and adaptive tax policies that move beyond conventional physical-presence rules.

detail.abstract: This study examines the challenges of profit allocation on digital platforms, focusing on the mechanisms that shape revenue distribution among stakeholders. Using a mixed-method approach, the research combines a critical literature review, detailed case studies of leading digital platforms, and analysis of financial and operational data extracted from platform reports. Findings indicate significant disparities in revenue allocation, often influenced by algorithm-driven biases that favor certain participants over others. The study also identifies regulatory gaps that exacerbate these inequities, highlighting the limited oversight of platform-based economic interactions. These challenges underscore the complexities of balancing platform growth, user incentives, and fair compensation. The analysis further reveals that existing profit-sharing models frequently lack transparency and adaptability, limiting stakeholders' ability to negotiate equitable outcomes. Based on these insights, the study argues for the development of transparent and adaptive profit-sharing frameworks that account for algorithmic impacts and evolving regulatory environments. Such frameworks could enhance fairness, improve stakeholder trust, and support sustainable digital platform ecosystems. The findings contribute to ongoing debates on platform governance and digital economy regulation, providing actionable recommendations for policymakers, platform designers, and scholars interested in equitable digital markets (Deng et al., 2022; Li & Qi, 2023; Tirole, 2023).

detail.abstract: The rapid growth of the digital economy has significantly transformed global trade, creating novel challenges for the collection of Value Added Tax (VAT) and Goods and Services Tax (GST). Traditional tax frameworks often struggle to keep pace with digital transactions, resulting in efficiency gaps and compliance issues. This study employs a mixed-methods approach, combining an extensive literature review, comparative case studies of selected countries, and statistical analysis of tax collection data to assess the effectiveness of existing VAT/GST systems in digital contexts. The findings indicate persistent inefficiencies in tax administration, low compliance rates among digital service providers, and the critical role of digital platforms in both facilitating and complicating taxation. Furthermore, the study highlights policy implications, including the need for clearer regulatory guidelines and enhanced enforcement mechanisms. The main conclusion underscores that VAT/GST systems require comprehensive reforms, integrating technological solutions such as automated reporting and blockchain-based monitoring, alongside strengthened international cooperation, to ensure efficient, transparent, and equitable tax collection in the rapidly evolving digital economy.

title: The Path to Godhood for Large Language Models (Extended Edition): Temporal Dimension Expansion and the Life-or-Death Boundary of Intent Isolation
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: The Path to Godhood for Large Language Models (Extended Edition): Temporal Dimension Expansion and the Life-or-Death Boundary of Intent Isolation
detail.abstract: Despite explosive parameter growth and extended context windows, current large language models (LLMs) remain trapped by the dual defects of "goldfish memory" and "intent contamination." Building upon the original Temporal Dimension Expansion, this extended edition systematically diagnoses the fatal consequences of intent contamination-from theme-mixing in user interactions to potential doomsday scenarios in physical robots (such as the "baby-in-oven" tragedy caused by multi-task switching failures). The author proposes a comprehensive three-layer framework: a temporal memory layer (decay, compression, hooks, hierarchy), an intent routing layer (detection, isolation, multi-threading, task persistence), and a user relationship layer (profile, warmth, continuous consciousness). The conclusion pronounces a harsh verdict: without intent isolation and continuous consciousness, LLMs will never achieve godhood; premature deployment in the physical world will inevitably breed catastrophe. This is not merely technical optimization-it is the life-or-death baseline for AGI safety.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出当前大型语言模型存在"金鱼记忆"和"意图污染"双重缺陷，提出三层框架解决意图隔离和持续意识问题，警告缺乏这些机制将导致AGI安全灾难。
AI.research_question: 如何解决大型语言模型中的"意图污染"问题，确保在物理世界部署时的安全性？
AI.motivation: 尽管参数规模和上下文窗口不断扩大，当前LLMs仍存在"金鱼记忆"和"意图污染"双重缺陷，可能导致物理世界灾难性后果（如"婴儿入烤箱"悲剧）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于原始时间维度扩展理论，提出三层框架：时间记忆层（衰减、压缩、钩子、层次）、意图路由层（检测、隔离、多线程、任务持久性）、用户关系层（用户画像、温暖度、持续意识）。
AI.method: 系统性诊断意图污染的致命后果，从用户交互中的主题混合到物理机器人中的末日场景分析，提出三层技术框架解决方案。
AI.findings: 意图污染会导致主题混合和多任务切换失败，在物理世界部署可能引发灾难；缺乏意图隔离和持续意识将阻碍LLMs达到"神级"能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统化诊断意图污染的理论框架；2. 提出时间维度扩展的三层架构理论；3. 建立意图隔离与持续意识作为AGI安全基线的理论标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供可实施的三层技术框架；2. 警告物理世界部署的风险；3. 为AGI安全提供具体的技术路线图；4. 提出防止"婴儿入烤箱"等灾难的实践方案。

title: Influence of Parental Involvement and Peer Pressure on Academic Performance of Students in Girei LGA, Adamawa State

detail.title: Influence of Parental Involvement and Peer Pressure on Academic Performance of Students in Girei LGA, Adamawa State
detail.abstract: The study surveyed the influence of parental involvement and peer group on academic performance of students of Girei Local Government with reference to Basic Science. The study adopted a dual research design, with a structured questionnaire. The study has 88 sampled size and employed the SPSS tools for its data analysis and the PPMC and linear regression in testing the null hypothesis. The findings of the study are: there is significant relationship between parental involvement and students’ academic performance in Basic Science, (F(86, 1)=126.684, p<0.05, there is significant relationship between peer group and students’ academic performance in Basic Science, (F(86, 1)=12.288, p<0.05 and there is significant relationship between parental involvement, peer group and students’ academic performance in Basic Science, (F(86, 2)=63.254, p<0.05. It is recommended among others that the government and ministry of education should ensure that trained counselors are posted in all schools and colleges so as to provide preventive counseling services and modify the bahaviours of the students who perchance have been negatively influenced by peers.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了父母参与和同伴群体对Girei地方政府学生基础科学学业成绩的影响，发现两者均与学业成绩显著相关，建议学校配备专业辅导员提供预防性咨询服务。

AI.findings: 1. 父母参与与学生基础科学学业成绩显著相关(F(86,1)=126.684, p<0.05)；2. 同伴群体与学业成绩显著相关(F(86,1)=12.288, p<0.05)；3. 父母参与和同伴群体共同与学业成绩显著相关(F(86,2)=63.254, p<0.05)。

detail.abstract: Blockchain technology, initially developed to support cryptocurrencies, has rapidly evolved as a transformative tool across various sectors, including taxation. Its decentralized, immutable, and transparent nature offers significant potential for enhancing tax administration by improving compliance and accountability. This study investigates the role of blockchain in strengthening tax transparency and reducing evasion, addressing a critical challenge faced by governments worldwide. A mixed-methods approach was employed, combining a comprehensive literature review with case studies of countries and organizations implementing blockchain in tax systems, alongside analysis of relevant data on compliance and audit efficiency. The findings indicate that blockchain adoption enhances tax administration by providing secure, tamper-proof audit trails, reducing opportunities for fraudulent reporting, and fostering greater trust between taxpayers and authorities. Moreover, blockchain enables real-time monitoring of transactions, which streamlines reporting processes and minimizes administrative delays. The study concludes that integrating blockchain into tax systems offers a robust, transparent, and efficient mechanism for combating tax evasion while promoting accountability and public confidence. Policymakers and tax authorities are encouraged to consider blockchain-driven solutions as part of broader digital transformation initiatives, with attention to regulatory frameworks, technical infrastructure, and stakeholder engagement.

AI.tldr: 区块链技术通过其去中心化、不可篡改和透明的特性，能够增强税收透明度、减少逃税行为，为税务管理提供安全高效的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 区块链技术如何增强税收透明度并减少逃税？
AI.motivation: 全球政府面临税收透明度和逃税问题的挑战，区块链技术具有去中心化、不可篡改和透明的特性，为解决这些问题提供了潜在方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链技术的去中心化、不可篡改性和透明度理论，探讨其在税务管理中的应用潜力。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：综合文献综述 + 实施区块链税务系统的国家和组织案例研究 + 合规性和审计效率相关数据分析。
AI.findings: 区块链采用通过提供安全的防篡改审计追踪、减少欺诈报告机会、增强纳税人与当局之间的信任来改善税务管理；支持实时交易监控，简化报告流程，减少行政延误。
AI.theory_contributions: 为区块链在公共部门治理特别是税务管理中的应用提供了理论支持，验证了去中心化技术对增强透明度和减少逃税的理论可行性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和税务当局提供了区块链驱动的解决方案建议，包括监管框架、技术基础设施和利益相关者参与等方面的实施指导。

title: The Lean Idol: Reengineering K-pop Business Models through Agile Iteration and Participatory Governance

detail.title: The Lean Idol: Reengineering K-pop Business Models through Agile Iteration and Participatory Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author reports no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The traditional K-pop production model is characterized by high upfront investment risks, long payback periods, and rigid organizational structures, often described as a "high-risk, high-return" blockbuster strategy. In the volatile digital media environment, this study investigates how Lean Startup and Agile management principles can mitigate industry-specific risks and enhance operational efficiency. Focusing on the case of ModHaus Inc. and its modular group tripleS, this research utilizes a unique dataset comprising internal financial records (COGS, SG&A), organizational charts, and digital performance metrics, benchmarked against nine comparable non-listed entertainment agencies. The findings reveal that adopting a matrix organizational structure and an MVP (Minimum Viable Product) strategy-via rotating subunits-significantly optimizes cost structures and accelerates the break-even point (J-curve effect). Furthermore, the study demonstrates that blockchain-based participatory governance functions as a mechanism to validate market demand before heavy investment, reducing the uncertainty of intuition-based decision-making. This research provides strategic implications for media entrepreneurs by demonstrating how data-driven iteration and platform-mediated governance can transform the sustainable business model of the entertainment industry.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在K-pop产业中应用精益创业和敏捷管理原则，通过矩阵组织结构、MVP策略和区块链治理来降低风险、优化成本结构并加速盈亏平衡。
AI.research_question: 精益创业和敏捷管理原则如何能够缓解K-pop产业特有的风险并提升运营效率？
AI.motivation: 传统K-pop制作模式存在高前期投资风险、长回报周期和僵化的组织结构问题，在波动的数字媒体环境中需要更有效的风险管理方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精益创业理论、敏捷管理原则、J曲线效应、模块化组织理论、区块链治理理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，聚焦ModHaus Inc.及其模块化团体tripleS，使用包含内部财务记录、组织结构图和数字绩效指标的独特数据集，并与九家可比非上市娱乐机构进行基准比较。
AI.findings: 采用矩阵组织结构和MVP策略（通过轮换子团体）显著优化了成本结构并加速了盈亏平衡点（J曲线效应）；基于区块链的参与式治理能够在重大投资前验证市场需求，减少基于直觉决策的不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将精益创业和敏捷管理理论扩展到娱乐产业，发展了模块化组织在创意产业中的应用理论，提出了区块链治理在需求验证中的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为媒体创业者提供战略启示，展示数据驱动迭代和平台中介治理如何转变娱乐产业的可持续商业模式，提供具体的组织结构设计和风险管理方法。

title: Geospatial Modeling of Urban Transportation Networks for Disaster Resilience
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Geospatial Modeling of Urban Transportation Networks for Disaster Resilience
detail.abstract: This study evaluates the resilience of urban transportation networks to disasters using geospatial modeling techniques. Leveraging Geographic Information Systems (GIS), network analysis, and disaster scenario simulations, the research identifies critical nodes, vulnerability hotspots, and potential bottlenecks within the urban transportation infrastructure. Findings reveal that specific intersections and transit corridors are disproportionately susceptible to disruptions, highlighting areas where targeted interventions can significantly improve network robustness. Simulation results further demonstrate how cascading failures can propagate through the network, underscoring the importance of preemptive planning. The study concludes that GIS-based geospatial modeling offers a practical and effective framework for assessing transportation vulnerability and informing strategic resilience measures. Based on these insights, it is recommended that urban planners and policymakers integrate real-time geospatial analytics into disaster preparedness and transportation planning processes to enhance urban resilience and ensure continuity of mobility during emergencies.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用地理信息系统（GIS）、网络分析和灾害情景模拟，评估城市交通网络对灾害的韧性，识别关键节点、脆弱性热点和潜在瓶颈，为城市规划和灾害准备提供实用框架。
AI.research_question: 如何评估城市交通网络对灾害的韧性？哪些交通节点和走廊最容易受到破坏？如何通过地理空间建模提高城市交通网络的鲁棒性？
AI.motivation: 城市交通网络在灾害中容易受到破坏，影响应急响应和城市功能。需要科学方法识别脆弱环节，为城市规划提供决策支持，提高城市整体韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地理信息系统（GIS）理论、网络分析理论、灾害韧性理论、复杂系统理论和级联失效理论，构建城市交通网络韧性评估框架。
AI.method: 采用地理信息系统（GIS）建模、网络分析技术和灾害情景模拟方法，结合空间数据分析识别关键节点和脆弱性热点，通过模拟级联失效评估网络韧性。
AI.findings: 研究发现特定交叉口和交通走廊对破坏具有不成比例的敏感性；级联失效会在网络中传播；GIS地理空间建模是评估交通脆弱性的有效框架；实时地理空间分析应整合到灾害准备中。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了基于GIS的城市交通网络韧性评估理论框架；深化了对交通网络级联失效机制的理解；为城市韧性理论提供了实证支持和方法论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者提供识别关键脆弱点的实用工具；为政策制定者提供基于证据的决策支持；推荐将实时地理空间分析整合到灾害准备和交通规划中；提出针对性干预措施提高网络鲁棒性。

title: GIS-based Assessment of Environmental Risk Exposure in Informal Settlements
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: GIS-based Assessment of Environmental Risk Exposure in Informal Settlements
detail.abstract: Informal settlements worldwide are highly susceptible to environmental hazards due to inadequate infrastructure, high population density, and limited access to basic services. Assessing environmental risk exposure in these areas is crucial for sustainable urban planning and disaster risk reduction. This study aims to map, quantify, and analyse environmental risks in informal settlements using Geographic Information Systems (GIS) integrated with Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA). Spatial data on land use, topography, drainage, and population distribution were compiled and analysed to identify vulnerability patterns. The results reveal significant hotspots of environmental risk, particularly in low-lying and densely populated zones, with strong correlations between risk exposure and socio-demographic factors such as income levels and population density. Critical areas for intervention were highlighted, providing actionable insights for targeted mitigation strategies. The findings demonstrate the effectiveness of GIS-based approaches in visualising and prioritising environmental vulnerabilities, offering valuable guidance for policymakers, urban planners, and disaster management agencies to enhance resilience in informal settlements.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用地理信息系统(GIS)与多准则决策分析(MCDA)相结合的方法，对非正规住区的环境风险进行制图、量化和分析，识别出高风险热点区域，为城市规划和灾害风险管理提供决策支持。
AI.research_question: 如何有效评估非正规住区的环境风险暴露程度？GIS与MCDA整合方法在识别和可视化环境脆弱性方面的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 全球非正规住区因基础设施不足、人口密度高、基本服务有限而高度易受环境危害，评估这些区域的环境风险对于可持续城市规划和灾害风险减少至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境风险暴露理论、脆弱性评估框架和空间决策支持系统理论，整合地理空间分析与多准则决策方法。
AI.method: 采用地理信息系统(GIS)与多准则决策分析(MCDA)相结合的方法，收集土地利用、地形、排水系统和人口分布等空间数据，进行综合分析和模式识别。
AI.findings: 研究识别出显著的环境风险热点区域，特别是低洼和人口密集区；发现风险暴露与社会人口因素（如收入水平和人口密度）之间存在强相关性；确定了需要干预的关键区域。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了整合GIS与MCDA的环境风险评估方法框架；验证了空间分析方法在非正规住区脆弱性评估中的有效性；为环境风险暴露理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、城市规划者和灾害管理机构提供了可操作的风险可视化工具；识别了需要优先干预的具体区域；为有针对性的减灾策略提供了科学依据；增强了非正规住区的韧性建设能力。

title: Land-Use Change and Compliance with Zoning Regulations in Rapidly Urbanizing Cities
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Land-Use Change and Compliance with Zoning Regulations in Rapidly Urbanizing Cities
detail.abstract: This study investigates patterns of land-use change and the degree of compliance with zoning regulations in rapidly urbanizing cities. Rapid urban expansion poses significant challenges to sustainable urban planning, often leading to conflicts between development pressures and regulatory frameworks (Hailu et al., 2024). Using a combination of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) analysis, remote sensing imagery, field surveys, and a review of zoning regulations, the study identifies spatial and temporal trends in land-use transformation and areas of regulatory non-compliance. The findings reveal significant shifts from agricultural and undeveloped lands to residential, commercial, and industrial uses, with notable concentrations of non-compliance in peripheral and high-demand urban zones. Socioeconomic factors, such as population growth, housing demand, and informal development, alongside environmental drivers, including topography and proximity to infrastructure, were found to influence these patterns (Biłozor et al., 2024). The study concludes that urban growth frequently outpaces existing regulatory mechanisms, highlighting the need for proactive monitoring, targeted enforcement, and adaptive urban planning strategies. Effective integration of spatial analysis with regulatory oversight is essential to guide sustainable urban development and mitigate the adverse effects of unplanned expansion.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了快速城市化城市中的土地利用变化模式及与分区法规的合规程度，发现城市增长常超越现有监管机制，需要主动监测和适应性规划策略。
AI.research_question: 快速城市化城市中土地利用变化模式是什么？与分区法规的合规程度如何？
AI.motivation: 快速城市扩张对可持续城市规划构成重大挑战，常导致发展压力与监管框架之间的冲突，需要理解土地利用变化模式与法规合规性之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市扩张理论、土地利用变化理论、监管合规理论、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 地理信息系统(GIS)分析、遥感影像、实地调查、分区法规审查
AI.findings: 发现农业和未开发土地向住宅、商业和工业用途的显著转变；外围和高需求城市区域存在明显的违规集中现象；社会经济因素（人口增长、住房需求、非正规发展）和环境驱动因素（地形、基础设施邻近度）影响这些模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对快速城市化背景下土地利用变化与监管合规之间动态关系的理解；为城市扩张理论提供了实证支持；扩展了监管合规理论在城市规划中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者提供识别违规集中区域的方法；强调主动监测和针对性执法的必要性；提出适应性城市规划策略；促进空间分析与监管监督的有效整合以指导可持续城市发展。

title: Urban Flood Susceptibility Modeling Using Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA): An Integrated GIS-Based Assessment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Urban Flood Susceptibility Modeling Using Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA): An Integrated GIS-Based Assessment
detail.abstract: Rapid urbanization combined with increasing climate variability has significantly intensified urban flood risk, particularly in rapidly growing cities with limited planning capacity (Wu et al., 2024). Urban flood susceptibility assessment has therefore become a critical tool for supporting sustainable land-use planning and disaster risk reduction strategies (Cai et al., 2024). This study applied a GIS-based multi-criteria decision analysis framework integrating the Analytic Hierarchy Process and weighted overlay techniques to model urban flood susceptibility (Nguyen et al., 2024). Multiple spatial data layers, including topography, land use and land cover, drainage density, rainfall intensity, and proximity to water bodies, were standardized and integrated within a GIS environment (Wu et al., 2024). Criterion weights were derived using pairwise comparisons to reflect the relative influence of physical and anthropogenic factors on flood occurrence (Cai et al., 2024). The resulting flood susceptibility map revealed distinct spatial patterns, with high-risk zones concentrated in low-lying areas characterized by dense drainage networks and extensive impervious surfaces (Nguyen et al., 2024). Land-use change and inadequate drainage infrastructure emerged as dominant contributors to elevated flood susceptibility (Wu et al., 2024). Overall, the findings demonstrate that GIS-based MCDA provides a transparent, systematic, and decision-oriented framework for urban flood risk assessment and planning (Cai et al., 2024).

AI.tldr: 本研究应用基于GIS的多准则决策分析框架，结合层次分析法和加权叠加技术，评估城市洪水易发性，识别高风险区域，为可持续土地利用规划和灾害风险减少提供支持。
AI.research_question: 如何利用GIS和多准则决策分析方法评估城市洪水易发性，识别高风险区域？
AI.motivation: 快速城市化与气候变化加剧了城市洪水风险，特别是在规划能力有限的快速成长城市中，需要有效的洪水易发性评估工具来支持可持续土地利用规划和灾害风险减少策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地理信息系统（GIS）的多准则决策分析（MCDA）框架，结合层次分析法（AHP）和加权叠加技术。
AI.method: 应用GIS-based MCDA框架，整合地形、土地利用与土地覆盖、排水密度、降雨强度、水体邻近度等多层空间数据，通过成对比较确定准则权重，使用加权叠加技术生成洪水易发性地图。
AI.findings: 洪水易发性地图显示明显的空间分布模式，高风险区域集中在低洼地区，这些区域具有密集排水网络和大量不透水表面；土地利用变化和排水基础设施不足是洪水易发性升高的主要因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了GIS-based MCDA为城市洪水风险评估和规划提供了一个透明、系统化和决策导向的框架，为多准则空间决策分析在城市洪水管理中的应用提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者和决策者提供了具体的洪水易发性地图，可用于指导土地利用规划、排水基础设施改善和灾害风险减少策略，支持可持续城市发展。

title: Graph Thinking: Network Cognition and Strategic Leadership in AI-Enabled Organizations

detail.title: Graph Thinking: Network Cognition and Strategic Leadership in AI-Enabled Organizations
detail.abstract: Contemporary organizations function as complex networks, yet leadership cognition remains dominated by linear metaphors that assume sequential causality and hierarchical control. This article introduces Graph Thinking as a multi-dimensional leadership capability comprising cognitive, analytical, and behavioral components that enable leaders to perceive, analyze, and deliberately shape organizational network structures. We position Graph Thinking at the intersection of systems thinking, social network analysis, and ecosystem strategy, arguing that it synthesizes these traditions while extending them to address the specific challenges of artificial intelligence deployment. Drawing on network science and strategic management theory, we develop a multi-level framework specifying how Graph Thinking manifests at individual, organizational, and ecosystem levels, with explicit attention to network dynamics and temporal evolution. Through illustrative thought experiments spanning diverse organizational contexts, we demonstrate how network properties function as diagnostic instruments for strategic decision-making. We argue that AI integration creates conditions that may reward explicit network mapping, while acknowledging this relationship is contingent and politically contested. The article contributes to strategic management literature by specifying measurement approaches for future empirical research, addressing power dynamics inherent in network legibility efforts, and providing actionable developmental frameworks. We conclude with boundary conditions, limitations, and directions for empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"图思维"作为领导力新能力，帮助领导者理解、分析和塑造组织网络结构，特别关注AI部署带来的挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何发展一种能够有效应对复杂组织网络环境的领导力认知框架？
AI.motivation: 当前组织运作如复杂网络，但领导力认知仍被线性隐喻主导，无法有效处理网络化组织结构和AI部署带来的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统思维、社会网络分析和生态系统战略的交叉融合，结合网络科学和战略管理理论。
AI.method: 理论框架开发，多层级框架构建，以及跨组织情境的思想实验演示。
AI.findings: 图思维包含认知、分析和行为三个维度，在个体、组织和生态系统层面均有表现；网络属性可作为战略决策的诊断工具；AI整合可能促进网络显性映射。
AI.theory_contributions: 为战略管理文献提供测量方法，处理网络可读性中的权力动态，提供可操作的发展框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者提供理解和塑造组织网络的实际工具，帮助应对AI部署带来的组织变革挑战。

title:
Non-Rational Competition, Competitive Firewalls, and Cash-FlowLongevity

Why Avoiding Competition Matters More than Winning it
affiliations: Fan Ge Institute

detail.title:
Non-Rational Competition, Competitive Firewalls, and Cash-FlowLongevity

Why Avoiding Competition Matters More than Winning it
detail.abstract: Classical strategy theory implicitly assumes rational competition, where firms exit markets when returns fall below opportunity cost. However, many contemporaryindustries—particularly in high-capacity, capital-intensive, or policy-influencedenvironments—operate under conditions of non-rational competition, where firms persist despite sustained losses. This paper argues that under non-rational competition, execution, scale, and efficiencyno longer determine long-term success. Instead, competitive firewalls—structural mechanisms that neutralize competition rather than outperform it—become decisive. We redefine competitive advantage as the ability to preserve cash-flowlongevityunder sustained competitive pressure. We further argue that cash itself functions as strategic optionality, enabling firms toavoid forced participation in destructive competition. Finally, we demonstrate whycompetitive firewalls cannot function without appropriate institutional protection, and why government policy plays a critical role in preventing involution.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了传统战略理论中理性竞争的假设，指出在非理性竞争环境下，执行力、规模和效率不再是长期成功的关键。相反，竞争防火墙（结构性机制）和现金流持久性成为决定性因素，而政府政策在防止行业内卷中发挥关键作用。
AI.research_question: 在非理性竞争环境下，什么因素决定企业的长期成功？传统战略理论中的执行力、规模和效率是否仍然有效？
AI.motivation: 传统战略理论基于理性竞争假设，但许多现代行业（特别是高产能、资本密集型或受政策影响的行业）存在非理性竞争现象，企业即使持续亏损仍坚持运营。这种现实与理论假设存在显著差距。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 非理性竞争理论：挑战传统理性竞争假设
2. 竞争防火墙理论：结构性机制而非运营优势
3. 现金流战略理论：现金作为战略选择权
4. 制度保护理论：政府政策在竞争中的作用
AI.method: 基于理论推演和概念分析的方法，通过逻辑论证构建理论框架，挑战传统战略理论假设，并提出新的概念模型。
AI.findings:
1. 在非理性竞争环境下，执行力、规模和效率不再是长期成功的决定因素
2. 竞争防火墙（结构性机制）成为关键成功因素
3. 竞争优势应重新定义为在持续竞争压力下保持现金流持久性的能力
4. 现金本身具有战略选择权价值，使企业能够避免参与破坏性竞争

detail.abstract: The new age of geographical information systems (GIS) significantly improves emergency preparedness through firefighting and flood response strategy hazard mapping. The application of hazard mapping through GIS technology improves response strategies and provides emergency preparedness insights. This study aims to assess the extent of the fusion of predictive analytics, spatial data, and AI modeling to refine the response and mitigation strategies. The study utilizes AI and predictive analytics to create scenarios that identify high-risk areas. The study blends AI and predictive analytics to create scenarios for predicting risk areas. The study blends AI and predictive analytics to create scenarios for predicting risk areas. The study blends AI and predictive analytics to create scenarios for predicting risk areas. The National Emergency Response Time (NERT) is a machine that operates as an emergency response time. The response time of stakeholders reduces emergency response times. Overall, the study highlights that visualization is essential in disaster risk reduction strategies.GIS improves community resilience and helps in formulating targeted mitigation strategies for floods and fires through evidence-based planning. These findings demonstrate the possible GIS integration into emergency management systems and call for the increased use of GIS in areas with frequent disasters.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了地理信息系统(GIS)如何通过融合预测分析、空间数据和AI建模来改进应急准备，特别是在消防和洪水响应策略方面。研究利用AI和预测分析创建情景来识别高风险区域，并强调可视化在灾害风险降低策略中的重要性。
AI.research_question: 预测分析、空间数据和AI建模的融合在多大程度上能够改进应急响应和减灾策略？
AI.motivation: GIS技术的新时代显著改善了应急准备，通过消防和洪水响应策略的危险地图绘制。危险地图的应用改进了响应策略并提供了应急准备洞察，但需要评估技术融合对策略优化的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地理信息系统(GIS)理论、预测分析理论、空间数据分析、人工智能建模、灾害风险管理理论、应急响应理论。
AI.method: 利用AI和预测分析创建情景来识别高风险区域，分析国家应急响应时间(NERT)机制，评估利益相关者响应时间对应急响应的影响。
AI.findings: 可视化在灾害风险降低策略中至关重要；GIS提高了社区韧性，并通过基于证据的规划帮助制定有针对性的洪水和火灾减灾策略；GIS可以整合到应急管理系统中；在频繁灾害地区应增加GIS的使用。
