title: Dynamic Control of Multiclass Multi-Episode Service Systems with Waiting Time Dependent Transitions
affiliations: University of Waterloo, University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, University of Waterloo and University of Waterloo

detail.title: Dynamic Control of Multiclass Multi-Episode Service Systems with Waiting Time Dependent Transitions
detail.abstract: Motivated by rehabilitation services, we study a service system with multiple heterogeneous customer classes and servers, in which customers may require multiple episodes of service to reach the desired outcome. After each episode, service outcomes are observed, and customers who do not achieve the desired outcome transition to another class for additional service. Empirical evidence shows that prolonged waiting times can worsen service outcomes and increase future congestion. Accordingly, we consider systems in which service outcomes and class transitions depend jointly on the service rate employed and the waiting time experienced. The system manager makes joint dynamic scheduling, service rate, and customer rejection decisions to minimize the long-run average expected cost comprising waiting, service, abandonment, rejection, and outcome-related transition costs, subject to firm throughput time deadlines. Since this control problem is analytically intractable, we develop a Brownian approximation in a heavy-traffic regime. Under complete resource pooling, we show that this problem is equivalent to a one-dimensional workload formulation and establish that the optimal solution is a two-sided barrier policy with a state-dependent drift rate. We translate this solution into a tractable control policy for the original system, which substantially outperforms static and myopic benchmarks. The results highlight that explicitly accounting for waiting time dependent service outcomes is essential, as myopic policies that ignore these effects perform poorly. Moreover, scheduling and service rate control influence the evolution of congestion through distinct mechanisms, and policies that leverage both levers consistently perform well. We also observe that scheduling priorities are driven by the trade-off between immediate costs and future congestion. Specifically, under low congestion, priority is given to classes with high immediate costs, while under high congestion, it shifts to classes whose waiting times most affect future congestion. Furthermore, the dynamic service rate control policy exhibits a regime-switching structure, favoring service outcome improvement under low congestion and future congestion mitigation under high congestion. Finally, while costly, abandonment mitigates the adverse effects of waiting time dependent service outcomes, acting as a partial substitute for dynamic service rate control.

AI.tldr: 本文研究康复服务系统中多类异质客户和服务器的调度问题，客户可能需要多次服务才能达到理想结果。服务结果和客户类别转换同时取决于服务速率和等待时间。作者开发了布朗近似方法，在重负载条件下将问题转化为一维工作负载公式，并证明最优解是带有状态依赖漂移率的双向屏障策略。该策略显著优于静态和短视基准。
AI.research_question: 在服务结果和客户类别转换同时依赖于服务速率和等待时间的多类异质客户服务系统中，如何通过动态调度、服务速率控制和客户拒绝决策来最小化长期平均期望成本？
AI.motivation: 康复服务中客户通常需要多次服务才能达到理想结果，且实证证据表明长时间等待会恶化服务结果并增加未来拥堵。需要开发能够考虑等待时间依赖服务结果的动态控制策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 排队理论、动态规划、布朗运动近似、重负载分析、资源池化理论、控制理论
AI.method: 在重负载条件下开发布朗近似方法，将原始控制问题转化为一维工作负载公式，证明最优解是带有状态依赖漂移率的双向屏障策略，并将其转化为原始系统的可处理控制策略。
AI.findings: 1) 考虑等待时间依赖的服务结果至关重要；2) 调度和服务速率控制通过不同机制影响拥堵演化；3) 调度优先级在低拥堵时关注高即时成本类别，高拥堵时转向最影响未来拥堵的类别；4) 动态服务速率控制呈现制度切换结构；5) 放弃虽成本高但能缓解等待时间依赖服务结果的不利影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 开发了考虑等待时间依赖服务结果和客户转换的排队系统布朗近似框架；2) 证明了在完全资源池化下问题等价于一维工作负载公式；3) 建立了最优解为双向屏障策略的理论结果；4) 提供了调度和服务速率控制相互作用的机制分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为康复服务等需要多次服务的系统提供了可实施的动态控制策略；2) 策略显著优于静态和短视基准；3) 揭示了调度和服务速率控制的协同作用；4) 提供了在不同拥堵水平下的决策指导原则。

title: The Channel of Singularity: The Metaphysical Foundation of Systemic Equilibration
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Channel of Singularity: The Metaphysical Foundation of Systemic Equilibration
detail.abstract:
The theoretical framework of the Anatomy of Chaos has previously established the structural mechanics of socio-political collapse and the gradient dynamics of expansion. However, the ultimate vector of these processes—the "why" behind the physics of history—remains to be defined. This paper proposes the final, metaphysical component of the model: the Channel of Singularity. We posit that the historical process is driven by a fundamental "Archi-Will"—a primordial systemic impulse towards the acceleration of complexity and the equalization of energy. Under specific conditions of critical internal entropy and external structural vacuum, the system undergoes a radical phase transition into a state of "superconductivity." In this mode, the friction of the Operating System is temporarily suspended, allowing the raw energy of the collective to flow without resistance into direct historical action.

To operationalize this dynamic, the paper introduces the concept of the "Agent of Singularity"—a leader whose internal psychological configuration resonates perfectly with the structural void of the crisis. While this selection mechanism bears a functional resemblance to Darwinian natural selection, and the resulting projection of power recalls the Nietzschean Will to Power, our model integrates these phenomena into a new synthesis: the individual is not the source of the will, but the necessary conduit for a systemic imperative. Furthermore, we argue that the trajectory of this acceleration is not random. The system tends towards a state where the velocity of progress approaches infinity and the distribution of energy becomes perfectly uniform. We propose that this point of absolute equilibrium represents not a thermodynamic "heat death," but a critical Phase Transition—a moment of saturation required for the system to shift to a fundamentally higher level of organization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"奇点通道"作为历史进程的最终驱动力，认为历史由"原始意志"驱动，在特定条件下系统会进入"超导"状态，个体领导者作为"奇点代理"成为系统意志的传导通道，最终系统趋向能量均匀分布的绝对平衡状态，实现向更高组织层次的相变。
AI.research_question: 历史进程的根本驱动力是什么？为什么在特定历史时期会出现系统性的加速变革和能量重新分配？
AI.motivation: 虽然"混沌解剖"理论框架已建立了社会政治崩溃的结构力学和扩张的梯度动力学，但这些过程的最终向量——历史物理学背后的"为什么"尚未定义，需要补充模型的最终形而上学组成部分。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 混沌解剖理论（Anatomy of Chaos）的社会政治崩溃结构力学
2. 奇点通道（Channel of Singularity）作为形而上学组件
3. 原始意志（Archi-Will）作为系统冲动
4. 达尔文自然选择的功能类比
5. 尼采权力意志（Will to Power）的投影
AI.method: 理论建模方法，通过概念整合和理论综合，将形而上学组件与现有结构力学框架相结合，提出新的系统动力学模型。
AI.findings:
1. 历史进程由"原始意志"驱动，这是一种朝向复杂性加速和能量均衡的系统冲动
2. 在临界内部熵和外部结构真空条件下，系统会进入"超导"状态，集体能量无阻力流动
3. "奇点代理"作为领导者，其心理结构与危机结构真空共振，成为系统意志的传导通道
4. 系统趋向于进步速度接近无限、能量分布完全均匀的绝对平衡状态
5. 这种平衡不是热力学"热寂"，而是向更高组织层次相变所需的饱和点
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"奇点通道"作为历史进程的最终形而上学驱动力
2. 整合了达尔文选择和尼采权力意志，形成新的理论综合
3. 重新概念化了系统平衡状态，从热寂转向相变
4. 建立了"原始意志-奇点代理-超导状态"的系统动力学模型
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为理解历史加速变革时期提供了分析框架
2. 为识别系统临界状态和领导力选择机制提供了理论依据
3. 为预测系统相变时机和方向提供了概念工具
4. 为政策制定者在系统转型期提供决策参考

title: “I Felt Like that was my Second Home”: A Qualitative Study of Adult Engagement with Opportunity Youth in a Workforce Development Program
affiliations: Boston University School of Social Work, Boston University - School of Social Work (BUSSW), Boston University - School of Social Work (BUSSW), YouthBuild Global, YouthBuild Global and YouthBuild Global

detail.title: “I Felt Like that was my Second Home”: A Qualitative Study of Adult Engagement with Opportunity Youth in a Workforce Development Program
detail.abstract: Specific features of program cultures that contribute significantly to positive youth outcomes have been identified. Yet, focused attention to what program staff actually do to cultivate this kind of program culture with opportunity youth (young people between the ages of 16 and 24 who are neither enrolled in school nor participating in the labor market) is limited. This exploratory qualitative study sought to identify specific staff attitudes and behaviors that youth program alumni and current staff identify as contributing to the promotion of core features of a positive and effective program culture. Focus group and individual interviews were conducted with 37 program staff and 15 youth program alumni were interviewed individually. A thematic analysis of these interviews resulted in the identification of specific staff attitudes, approaches, and actions that were perceived to have contributed to the cultivation of four aspects of program culture, namely belonging, respect, high expectations, and love. An unanticipated finding was both the staff and youth alumni’s emphasis on the importance of the inter-staff relationships for promoting a strong and positive program culture.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过质性访谈发现，针对机会青年（16-24岁未就学未就业青年）的项目中，工作人员的态度和行为对培育积极项目文化（归属感、尊重、高期望和关爱）至关重要，意外发现是工作人员间的关系对项目文化也有重要影响。
AI.research_question: 针对机会青年的项目中，工作人员采取哪些具体态度和行为来培育积极有效的项目文化？
AI.motivation: 虽然已识别出促进青年积极发展的项目文化特征，但对工作人员如何具体培育这种文化（特别是针对机会青年）的研究有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 积极青年发展理论，项目文化理论，社会支持理论
AI.method: 探索性质性研究，采用焦点小组和个人访谈，对37名项目工作人员和15名项目校友进行访谈，进行主题分析
AI.findings: 识别出工作人员的态度、方法和行动对培育项目文化四个方面的贡献：归属感、尊重、高期望和关爱；意外发现是工作人员间关系对促进积极项目文化的重要性
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了项目文化培育的理论框架，强调了工作人员具体实践的重要性，揭示了工作人员间关系作为项目文化关键要素的新维度
AI.practical_contributions: 为青年项目工作人员提供具体可操作的态度和行为指南，强调团队建设的重要性，为项目设计和培训提供实证依据

title: A Historical Account of The Engineering of Arkansas' Corrections

detail.title: A Historical Account of The Engineering of Arkansas' Corrections

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares there is no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research or interpretation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research didn't involve human subjects, interviews, or identifiable personal data, and therefore didn't require institutional ethics approval. The analysis is based on publicly available records, historical documentation and secondary sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding, and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper is a historical analysis of the Arkansas prison system. We are examining its development from post Civil War penal labor practices to its present conditions regarding overcrowding, institutional instability, drug proliferation, environmental hazards, and declining candor. I have drawn on judicial opinions, legislative history, public records, and documented administrative practices, and this study demonstrates that Arkansas correctional challenges are predictable outcomes of continued policy decisions. I want to assert attention to the rise of illegal drugs within the state's correctional facilities, the restriction of books and mail, the demeaning physical infrastructure, including wastewater systems, and the institutional barriers that prevent importance and supervision. This analysis is a deliberate, factual and accessible resource for policymakers, researchers, journalists, and advocates working to understand the roots of Arkansas' correctional crisis.

AI.tldr: 本文对阿肯色州监狱系统进行历史分析，追溯其从内战后刑罚劳动实践到当前状况的发展，揭示监狱过度拥挤、制度不稳定、毒品泛滥、环境危害等问题是持续政策决策的可预测结果。
AI.research_question: 阿肯色州监狱系统如何从内战后刑罚劳动实践发展到当前的危机状况？监狱面临的过度拥挤、制度不稳定、毒品泛滥、环境危害等问题与历史政策决策有何关联？
AI.motivation: 阿肯色州监狱系统面临严重危机，包括过度拥挤、制度不稳定、毒品泛滥、环境危害等问题，需要系统性的历史分析来理解这些问题的根源，为政策制定者、研究人员、记者和倡导者提供事实依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史制度主义分析框架，关注制度变迁与政策决策的长期影响；刑罚劳动历史分析；监狱系统发展的路径依赖理论。
AI.method: 历史分析方法，基于司法意见、立法历史、公共记录和行政实践文档的档案研究；政策决策的纵向分析。
AI.findings: 阿肯色州监狱系统的当前挑战是持续政策决策的可预测结果；监狱内非法毒品泛滥；书籍和邮件受到限制；物理基础设施（包括废水系统）存在严重问题；制度性障碍阻碍了重要监督和管理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了监狱系统发展的历史制度主义分析案例；展示了政策决策如何通过路径依赖导致系统性危机；为理解刑罚制度变迁提供了历史视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解阿肯色州监狱危机根源的事实依据；为研究人员、记者和倡导者提供了可访问的分析资源；指出了需要改革的具体领域，包括毒品控制、通信限制、基础设施改善和监管机制。

title: The Swiss Business in China Survey 2025 -- includes The Chinese Business in Switzerland Survey 2025
affiliations: University of St. Gallen - SoM: School of Management, China Integrated and Swiss Centers Group

detail.title: The Swiss Business in China Survey 2025 -- includes The Chinese Business in Switzerland Survey 2025
detail.abstract:
The Swiss Business in China Survey 2025 provides rich once more findings and insights on the new market environment that Swiss businesses face in China.

Despite the ever more challenging business climate, the 2025 respondents are on average slightly more confident than they were in 2024. This is particularly so when they are asked to view the outlook on a 5-year time horizon. Indeed, we have to go back to the 2014 survey to match the level of confidence seen today if one excludes the outlier optimism of 2021 when China operated under a zero- COVID policy and supplied the rest of the world.

Nonetheless, there are caveats and this annual report identifies the human, financial, and competitive challenges and expectations of Swiss companies active in China. In a new development, this year’s survey also aims to understand the differences in perception between managers responsible for Chinese operations at Head Offices and those running the businesses on the ground. 

The 2025 survey results also supplies a variety of key insights, including:

• Long-term confidence is matched by stable investment intentions, with about 50% of respondents identifying China as a top-3 market for investment. This is the case both for managers of subsidiaries and those at headquarters. 

• The competitive environment has changed dramatically over the last three years with Chinese companies increasingly competing on quality, technological innovation, and brand recognition.

• With the exception of increasing Chinese pressure to produce locally, Swiss companies describe a more level playing field. They also have more confidence that they can win legal disputes in China.

This report also includes the first systematic study of Chinese enterprises and institutions operating in Switzerland. The Chinese Business in Switzerland 2025 research project mirrors the Swiss Business in China survey and combines a structured questionnaire enriched with in-depth interviews. Key Insights include:

• Switzerland serves as a strategic foothold, not just a profit center.

• “Light capital, strong management” is the right approach for mature markets.

• Cross-cultural, dual-context talent is a critical bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 2025年瑞士在华商业调查报告显示，尽管营商环境更具挑战性，但瑞士企业对中国的长期信心略有回升，约50%受访者将中国列为前三大投资市场。同时，中国企业在瑞士的商业活动研究首次系统开展，揭示了瑞士作为战略支点而非单纯利润中心的重要性。
AI.research_question: 瑞士企业在中国面临的新市场环境如何？瑞士与中国企业在对方市场的商业活动、挑战和战略有何差异？
AI.motivation: 随着中国商业环境变化和竞争加剧，需要了解瑞士企业在中国的最新适应情况，同时首次系统研究中国企业在瑞士的商业活动，为双边商业关系提供全面洞察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际商务理论、跨国企业战略管理、跨文化管理、市场进入策略、竞争动态分析
AI.method: 结构化问卷调查（瑞士在华企业调查）结合深度访谈；首次对中国在瑞士企业进行镜像研究，采用相同方法
AI.findings: 1) 瑞士企业对华长期信心略有回升，50%将中国列为前三大投资市场；2) 中国企业在质量、技术创新和品牌方面竞争加剧；3) 营商环境更公平，法律争端解决信心增强；4) 中国企业在瑞士将瑞士视为战略支点而非单纯利润中心；5) 跨文化人才是关键瓶颈
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了跨国企业在成熟市场与新兴市场的战略差异理论，提出了"轻资本、强管理"的成熟市场进入模式，深化了跨文化人才在双边商业关系中的关键作用理论

title: The Inclusive Communication and Community Involvement in the Transformation of Street Children's Behaviour

detail.title: The Inclusive Communication and Community Involvement in the Transformation of Street Children's Behaviour

declarations.declarationOfInterest: he author declares that there is no conflict of interest regarding the publication of this article
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was conducted in accordance with ethical research principles. Informed consent was obtained from all participants, and participants’ anonymity and confidentiality were strictly maintained throughout the research process

detail.abstract: This article analyses the role of inclusive communication in facilitating behavioural change among street children in Makassar City, with a focus on community-based communication strategies. A qualitative case study approach was used, utilising participatory observation with 75 street children and in-depth interviews with seven volunteers and three street children from the Makassar Street Children Care Community (KPAJ). Data were analysed thematically and narratively using Nvivo Pro 12 to identify patterns in communication dynamics and behavioural change outcomes. Findings indicate that inclusive communication emphasising empathy, dialogue, and active participation significantly shapes street children's self-confidence, discipline, and motivation to learn. Volunteers acted as facilitators, creating a safe space for expression and reinforcing positive behavioural change. This study highlights adaptive and nonformal communication tailored to the psychosocial needs of children, in line with Freiran's theories of social empowerment and dialogic pedagogy. This research demonstrates that community-driven inclusive communication models are crucial in supporting sustainable behavioural transformation among street children. The KPAJ approach offers a replicable framework for NGOs and policymakers, highlighting the importance of psychosocial support alongside educational interventions. Future studies should explore scalability across cultural contexts and long-term impacts.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了包容性沟通在促进望加锡市街头儿童行为改变中的作用，重点关注基于社区的沟通策略。研究发现强调共情、对话和积极参与的包容性沟通显著影响街头儿童的自信心、纪律和学习动机。
AI.research_question: 包容性沟通如何促进望加锡市街头儿童的行为改变？
AI.motivation: 需要探索有效的社区沟通策略来支持街头儿童的行为转变和可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: Freire的社会赋权理论和对话式教学法理论。
AI.method: 定性案例研究方法，采用参与式观察（75名街头儿童）和深度访谈（7名志愿者和3名街头儿童），使用Nvivo Pro 12进行主题和叙事分析。
AI.findings: 强调共情、对话和积极参与的包容性沟通显著塑造了街头儿童的自信心、纪律和学习动机；志愿者作为促进者创造了安全表达空间并强化了积极行为改变。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Freire的社会赋权理论和对话式教学法应用于街头儿童干预，发展了适应儿童心理社会需求的非正式沟通理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: KPAJ方法为NGO和政策制定者提供了可复制的框架，强调心理社会支持与教育干预相结合的重要性，支持街头儿童的可持续行为转变。

detail.abstract: The emergence of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its applications, such as chatbots, virtual reality, augmented reality, GenAI, voice commerce, and visual search, has considerably changed purchase decision-making. The current study aims to assess the awareness level of AI applications and measure the usage level of these applications among Pollachi commerce stream students. Furthermore, the study identifies the factors that hinder the adoption of AI applications in the purchasing decision-making process. The study measures the impact of demographic variables, awareness, and hesitation factors on the usage of AI applications in purchase decision-making. The study is quantitative and qualitative. We conducted a focus group interview with 10 students to gain a preliminary understanding. The data was collected from 108 students through proportionate stratified sampling from Pollachi commerce stream students. The results from the focus group and questionnaire were systematically analysed. The findings of the study were discussed, and appropriate suggestions were proposed to enhance the usage level of AI applications in purchase decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了商科学生对AI应用（如聊天机器人、虚拟现实等）的认知和使用水平，识别了阻碍AI在购买决策中采用的因素，并分析了人口统计变量、认知和犹豫因素对AI使用的影响。
AI.research_question: 商科学生对AI应用的认知水平如何？他们在购买决策中使用AI应用的程度如何？哪些因素阻碍了AI应用在购买决策过程中的采用？
AI.motivation: AI及其应用（聊天机器人、虚拟现实、增强现实、生成式AI、语音商务、视觉搜索等）的出现显著改变了购买决策过程，但学生对AI应用的认知和使用情况尚不明确，需要研究阻碍采用的因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型（TAM）、创新扩散理论、消费者行为理论、数字鸿沟理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：1）定性研究：对10名学生进行焦点小组访谈；2）定量研究：通过比例分层抽样从108名商科学生收集问卷数据，系统分析焦点小组和问卷结果。
AI.findings: 研究发现商科学生对AI应用的认知水平、使用程度，识别了阻碍采用的具体因素，并揭示了人口统计变量、认知和犹豫因素对AI应用使用的影响模式。

title: Sustaining Anatomical Education Through Crisis: The Interplay of Technology, Institutional Practices, and Organizational Learning During Pandemic Disruptions
affiliations: and Rajalakshmi Engineering College

detail.title: Sustaining Anatomical Education Through Crisis: The Interplay of Technology, Institutional Practices, and Organizational Learning During Pandemic Disruptions
detail.abstract: Background: The COVID -19 pandemic triggered a sudden, universal shift of the classical, cadaver-based model of teaching anatomy to mainly online formats, thus threatening the quality and continuity of the foundational aspect of medical education.Objective: This paper has attempted to identify the organizational predictors of school resilience during systemic crises to go further and further to investigate institutional adaptability.Methods: A cross-sectional survey of 347 anatomy professors in 68 medical schools situated in different countries was conducted, and the data obtained were processed with the help of Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM).Results: The direct precursors of educational sustainability were technological readiness ( 0.42, p 0.01) and supportive institutions practices ( 0.38, p 0.01). The role of organizational learning as the central transformational mediator mediated 68% of these effects. Additionally, the technology-sustainability nexus showed moderation by the pandemic severity ( 0.31, p = 0.001), with disruption saliency strengthened when the pandemic gets worse.Conclusions: The sustainability of anatomy education in times of crisis does not depend entirely on digital means and more on the abilities of an institution to engage in systematic organizational learning and adaptive change.Significance: These research results provide an evidence-based framework on how to develop robust medical education that combines digital infrastructure and the culture of lifelong learning to protect physician training and, eventually, the quality of patient care.

AI.tldr: COVID-19疫情期间，解剖学教育从传统尸体教学转向在线模式。研究发现，教育可持续性的直接预测因素是技术准备度(0.42)和支持性机构实践(0.38)，其中68%的效果通过组织学习这一中介变量实现。疫情严重程度调节了技术与可持续性之间的关系。
AI.research_question: 在系统性危机期间，哪些组织因素能够预测医学院校的韧性？机构如何适应危机以维持解剖学教育质量？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情迫使解剖学教育从传统的尸体教学模式突然转向在线形式，这威胁到医学教育基础的质量和连续性，需要研究如何维持教育可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织韧性理论、组织学习理论、技术采纳理论、危机管理理论
AI.method: 对68所医学院校的347名解剖学教授进行横断面调查，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型(PLS-SEM)分析数据
AI.findings: 教育可持续性的直接预测因素是技术准备度(β=0.42, p<0.01)和支持性机构实践(β=0.38, p<0.01)。组织学习作为核心中介变量，解释了68%的效应。疫情严重程度调节了技术与可持续性之间的关系(β=0.31, p=0.001)，疫情越严重，技术对可持续性的影响越强。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 识别了危机期间教育可持续性的关键组织预测因素；2) 验证了组织学习在技术采纳与教育可持续性之间的中介作用；3) 揭示了疫情严重程度对技术-可持续性关系的调节效应；4) 扩展了组织韧性理论在医学教育领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为医学院校提供基于证据的框架，结合数字基础设施和终身学习文化；2) 强调机构需要系统性的组织学习和适应性变革；3) 帮助保护医师培训质量和患者护理质量；4) 为未来危机中的教育连续性提供指导。

title: Driving Technological Progress: The Causal Role of Educated Workers in China's Firm-Level Computer Technology Adoption

detail.title: Driving Technological Progress: The Causal Role of Educated Workers in China's Firm-Level Computer Technology Adoption

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) declare no conflicts of interest relevant to this work.

detail.abstract: Recent advancements in information and communication technology (ICT), automation, and artificial intelligence (AI) have reignited interest in factors influencing the adoption and subsequent diffusion of advanced technologies. This study employs an instrumental variable (IV) approach to investigate the causal effects of human capital on firm-level adoption of computer technology in China. We exploit the college enrollment expansion policy in China in 1999 and predict the city share of college-educated workers outside a firm as an exogenous source of variation to instrument for the firm’s human capital composition. Our main findings highlight a substantial causal link between the firm’s composition of college-educated workers and the degree of computer technology application within the firm’s production and operations processes. We demonstrate that this relationship remains remarkably stable against a battery of alternative specifications and robustness tests. Moreover, the estimated effects vary significantly based on the industry's high-tech status, with firms in high-tech industries deriving substantial benefits from educated workers in facilitating computer technology adoption. Affirming our main hypothesis, we find that workers with less than a college education exert no statistically significant effect on a firm's skill-biased technical adoption, highlighting the relative importance of upper-tail knowledge workers in early-stage technology adoption.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用工具变量方法，探讨人力资本对中国企业计算机技术采纳的因果影响。研究发现，企业大学学历员工比例显著促进计算机技术应用，这一效应在高科技行业尤为明显，而低于大学学历的员工则无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 人力资本如何影响中国企业的计算机技术采纳？特别是，企业大学学历员工比例是否对计算机技术应用有因果影响？
AI.motivation: 信息通信技术、自动化和人工智能的快速发展重新激发了人们对先进技术采纳和扩散影响因素的关注。在中国背景下，理解人力资本如何影响企业技术采纳对政策制定和企业实践具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技能偏向型技术变革理论，强调技术采纳需要特定技能水平的劳动力。人力资本理论，认为教育水平高的员工更能适应和采用新技术。
AI.method: 采用工具变量（IV）方法，利用1999年中国高校扩招政策作为外生冲击，预测城市层面大学学历员工比例作为企业人力资本构成的工具变量，以识别因果关系。
AI.findings: 1. 企业大学学历员工比例与计算机技术应用程度存在显著因果联系；2. 这一关系在不同模型设定和稳健性检验中保持稳定；3. 高科技行业企业从高学历员工中获益更大；4. 低于大学学历的员工对技术采纳无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为技能偏向型技术变革理论提供了中国情境下的因果证据；2. 强调了"知识精英"（大学学历员工）在早期技术采纳中的关键作用；3. 揭示了行业异质性在技术采纳过程中的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业人力资源管理提供指导：招聘高学历员工有助于技术采纳；2. 为政策制定者提供依据：高等教育扩张政策可能通过影响人力资本结构促进企业技术升级；3. 帮助高科技行业企业更好地利用人力资本优势。

title: Debt Rollover and Term Structure in an Overlapping Generations Economy
affiliations: Meiji University - School of Political Science and Economics

detail.title: Debt Rollover and Term Structure in an Overlapping Generations Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no relevant financial or non-financial interests to disclose.
declarations.funderStatement: Keiichi Morimoto is supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Numbers JP24K04895 and JP23K25535.

detail.abstract: This paper studies how debt rollover and government debt maturity shape the risk-free term structure in a stochastic overlapping generations economy. The government rolls over a stationary portfolio of non-contingent bonds and rebates the resulting net cash flows to households, splitting them between young and old cohorts. Because this split changes marginal utilities across cohorts, it endogenizes the one-period stochastic discount factor that prices every maturity. I characterize equilibrium as a fixed point in bond prices and provide conditions for existence and uniqueness of the equilibrium price system. The analysis describes which state-contingent rollover revenues can be generated through maturity choice and gives an exact decomposition of rollover gains into growth-related discounting, expected bondprice changes, and risk compensation (term premia). In a two-state log utility case, changing transfer incidence reverses yield curve slopes across states. Numerical exercises show sizable movements in yields and term premia with modest changes in intergenerational consumption shares.

AI.tldr: 本文研究债务展期和政府债务期限如何影响随机世代交叠经济中的无风险期限结构。政府展期非或有债券的固定组合，并将净现金流分配给年轻和年老世代。这种分配改变了不同世代的边际效用，从而内生化了定价所有期限的一期随机贴现因子。
AI.research_question: 债务展期和政府债务期限如何影响无风险利率的期限结构？
AI.motivation: 理解政府债务管理政策（特别是债务展期和期限结构）如何通过世代间的转移支付影响利率期限结构，这对于财政政策和货币政策协调具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机世代交叠模型（OLG），政府债务展期理论，期限结构理论，随机贴现因子理论
AI.method: 理论建模：构建随机世代交叠经济模型，政府展期固定债券组合，将净现金流分配给不同世代；将均衡描述为债券价格的固定点；提供均衡存在性和唯一性条件；进行数值模拟
AI.findings: 1. 政府通过期限选择可以产生特定的状态或有展期收入；2. 展期收益可精确分解为增长相关折现、预期债券价格变化和风险补偿（期限溢价）；3. 在两状态对数效用情况下，转移支付分配的变化会反转不同状态下的收益率曲线斜率；4. 数值模拟显示，代际消费份额的微小变化会导致收益率和期限溢价的大幅波动
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了政府债务展期与利率期限结构之间的理论联系；2. 将展期收益分解为三个组成部分；3. 证明了均衡存在性和唯一性条件；4. 揭示了代际转移支付如何内生决定随机贴现因子
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政府债务管理提供理论指导；2. 帮助理解财政政策如何影响利率期限结构；3. 为货币政策与财政政策协调提供分析框架；4. 揭示了代际分配政策对金融市场的重要影响

title: Denied At the Door: How Loan Barriers are Crippling Small Business Dreams

detail.title: Denied At the Door: How Loan Barriers are Crippling Small Business Dreams
detail.abstract: Small businesses employ about 44 percent of private sector workers in the United States and generate over 43 percent of national economic output, according to the U.S. Small Business Administration. You depend on these firms for daily services, employment, and neighborhood stability. Many owners still face major barriers when seeking bank financing. The Federal Reserve reported in the 2023 Small Business Credit Survey only 35 percent of employer firms received the full amount of funding requested. Black owned firms experienced denial rates close to double those of white owned firms, a trend also reported by Harvard Business School. This paper examines structural reasons behind these outcomes using my home of Glendale, California as a local case study. You see how post 2008 banking regulation, automated underwriting systems, and the loss of community banks restrict access to credit for small enterprises. The paper also outlines practical reforms supported by data from Community Development Financial Institutions and city backed loan programs. Without structural reform, you face slower business formation, reduced hiring, and weaker local economies.

AI.tldr: 本文以加州格伦代尔为案例，研究小企业融资障碍的结构性原因，分析后2008年银行监管、自动化审批系统和社区银行减少如何限制小企业信贷获取，并提出基于社区发展金融机构和城市贷款计划数据的改革方案。
AI.research_question: 美国小企业（特别是少数族裔拥有的企业）面临银行融资障碍的结构性原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 小企业占美国私营部门就业的44%和经济产出的43%，但融资困难阻碍其发展。2023年调查显示仅35%雇主企业获得全额融资，黑人企业被拒率接近白人企业的两倍，需要探究结构性原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性歧视理论、信贷市场分割理论、社区银行在地方经济发展中的作用理论、监管对信贷可获得性的影响理论。
AI.method: 以加州格伦代尔为地方案例研究，结合联邦储备银行小企业信贷调查数据、哈佛商学院研究报告、社区发展金融机构数据和城市贷款计划数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 后2008年银行监管收紧、自动化审批系统的偏见、社区银行减少共同限制了小企业信贷获取，导致种族融资差距扩大，影响企业形成、雇佣和地方经济活力。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对小企业融资障碍结构性原因的理解，特别是监管、技术和机构变化如何相互作用形成系统性障碍，为信贷市场不平等研究提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出基于社区发展金融机构和城市贷款计划的具体改革方案，为政策制定者、银行监管机构和地方政府提供改善小企业融资环境的实用建议。

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了在墨西哥帕丘卡理工大学的生物技术工程课程中整合低成本微控制器和开源技术，以解决公立大学获取昂贵工业硬件的财务障碍，展示了ESP32和人工智能等工具如何弥合理论知识与工业4.0实际应用之间的差距。
AI.research_question: 如何将低成本微控制器和开源技术整合到生物技术工程课程中，以克服公立大学在获取昂贵工业硬件方面的财务障碍？
AI.motivation: 公立大学面临获取昂贵工业硬件的财务障碍，需要寻找替代方案来提供实践性的工业4.0教育；COVID-19疫情凸显了远程实验室和灵活学习方案的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能力的学习理论、工业4.0教育框架、开源技术在教育中的应用理论、远程实验室教育模式。
AI.method: 在帕丘卡理工大学的生物技术工程课程中实施ESP32微控制器和人工智能工具，评估其替代传统可编程逻辑控制器(PLC)的效果，分析疫情期间远程实验室的应用。
AI.findings: 低成本微控制器和开源技术能够有效替代昂贵的工业硬件，成功弥合理论知识与实际工业4.0应用之间的差距；基于能力的学习和远程实验室在疫情期间特别重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在资源有限环境下实施工业4.0教育的理论框架，扩展了基于能力的学习理论在工程教育中的应用，丰富了开源技术在教育中的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公立大学提供了经济可行的工业4.0教育解决方案，展示了ESP32等低成本工具的实际应用案例，为疫情期间的远程工程教育提供了可复制的模式。

reference: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
title: Private Debt Financing and Product Market Expansion
affiliations: Monash Business School and Monash Business School

detail.title: Private Debt Financing and Product Market Expansion

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates how access to private debt (PD) financing affects product market expansion among manufacturers of consumer goods. Combining loan-level data with product-level sales, the evidence shows that during PD loan tenure, firms experience increased revenues driven by newly introduced products-both in existing and new product lines-and expansion into new geographic markets through entry into retail stores in previously unserved counties. While bank-only financing also increases revenues, PD is uniquely associated with these expansion strategies. Industry expertise and greater managerial support emerge as key mechanisms, highlighting the role of PD as a strategic partner rather than a passive financier. Our detailed data allow controlling for confounding factors such as access to bank financing and the presence of private equity intermediaries. These findings inform regulatory debates by demonstrating that private credit supports innovation and economic dynamism, despite concerns about market opacity and liquidity risk.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，获得私人债务融资的消费品制造商在产品市场扩张方面表现更佳，包括推出新产品（现有和新产品线）和进入新的地理市场（通过零售店进入未覆盖的县）。私人债务融资相比银行融资更能促进这些扩张策略，其关键机制在于行业专业知识和管理支持，使私人债务成为战略合作伙伴而非被动融资方。
AI.research_question: 私人债务融资如何影响消费品制造商的产品市场扩张？
AI.motivation: 研究私人债务融资对实体经济的影响，特别是在产品市场扩张方面的作用，为监管辩论提供实证依据，展示私人信贷如何支持创新和经济活力，尽管存在市场不透明和流动性风险的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 私人债务作为战略合作伙伴的理论框架，强调行业专业知识和管理支持在促进企业扩张中的作用，区别于传统银行融资的被动角色。
AI.method: 结合贷款层面数据和产品层面销售数据的实证分析，控制银行融资渠道和私募股权中介等混杂因素。
AI.findings: 在私人债务贷款期间，企业收入增加，主要来自新推出的产品（现有和新产品线）以及通过进入新县零售店实现的地理市场扩张。虽然银行融资也能增加收入，但私人债务与这些扩张策略有独特关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于阐明私人债务作为战略合作伙伴的角色，强调行业专业知识和管理支持作为关键机制，区别于传统融资理论中的被动融资方视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供实证证据，表明私人信贷支持创新和经济活力；为企业管理者提供融资策略参考，展示私人债务在促进市场扩张方面的独特价值。

title: Nutritional Substrates for Executive Function: Neural Requirements for Decision-Making Capacity

detail.title: Nutritional Substrates for Executive Function: Neural Requirements for Decision-Making Capacity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, and currently has no financial relationships with food, supplement, or pharmaceutical industries that could be perceived as influencing this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a narrative review synthesizing published research and does not involve human subjects, animal research, or primary data collection. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This paper does not report results from a clinical trial.

detail.abstract: Executive function and decision-making capacity depend on neural substrates that require specific nutritional inputs for development, maintenance, and repair. The prefrontal cortex, which governs planning, impulse control, and judgment, does not fully mature until approximately age 25 and remains dependent on adequate nutritional support throughout the lifespan. This paper examines the intersection of nutritional science and cognitive performance, identifying the specific substrates required for myelination, synaptic maintenance, neurotransmitter synthesis, and neuroplasticity. Evidence demonstrates that cholesterol, omega-3 fatty acids, choline, complete protein, and key micronutrients constitute non-negotiable inputs for optimal neural function. Modern dietary recommendations that restrict animal fats, emphasize plant-based patterns, and promote energy restriction may inadvertently compromise the biological foundations of decision-making capacity. These findings have implications for any field where sound thinking matters, including leadership, education, and professional performance.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文探讨了营养科学与认知表现之间的关系，指出执行功能和决策能力依赖于特定的营养输入。研究发现胆固醇、ω-3脂肪酸、胆碱、完全蛋白质和关键微量营养素是神经功能优化的必需物质，而现代限制动物脂肪、强调植物性饮食和能量限制的饮食建议可能损害决策能力的生物学基础。
AI.research_question: 营养输入如何影响执行功能和决策能力的神经基础？现代饮食建议是否可能损害认知表现？
AI.motivation: 执行功能和决策能力对领导力、教育和专业表现至关重要，但这些认知功能依赖于需要特定营养支持的神经基质。现代饮食建议可能无意中损害这些认知能力的生物学基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经科学、营养科学与认知心理学交叉框架，重点关注前额叶皮层的发育和维护机制，包括髓鞘形成、突触维护、神经递质合成和神经可塑性。
AI.method: 文献综述和证据综合方法，整合神经科学、营养学和认知心理学领域的研究证据，分析特定营养素对神经功能的影响。
AI.findings: 胆固醇、ω-3脂肪酸、胆碱、完全蛋白质和关键微量营养素是神经功能优化的必需物质。前额叶皮层直到约25岁才完全成熟，并且在整个生命周期中都需要充足的营养支持。现代限制动物脂肪、强调植物性饮食和能量限制的饮食建议可能损害决策能力的生物学基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了营养输入与认知功能之间的直接联系，提出了"非可协商的营养输入"概念，挑战了现代饮食建议的认知影响假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导力发展、教育政策和专业表现优化提供了基于营养的干预策略，建议重新评估当前饮食指南对认知健康的影响。

title: Functional Compensation Through Structured Challenge: A Neurobiological Framework for Leadership Development

detail.title: Functional Compensation Through Structured Challenge: A Neurobiological Framework for Leadership Development
detail.abstract: This paper introduces functional compensation through structured challenge as a neurobiologically grounded mechanism for leadership development. The prefrontal cortex, essential for executive function and decision-making, demonstrates remarkable plasticity in response to appropriately calibrated cognitive and emotional demands. However, neural systems do not remodel in response to comfort; they remodel in response to demand that exceeds current capacity while remaining survivable. This paper synthesizes current neuroscience research on brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF), synaptic plasticity, and stress-response calibration to argue that structured adversity, when administered by a qualified practitioner, is expected to produce measurable neurological and behavioral adaptation. The paper further examines how the Reasoned Leadership framework and its 3B Behavior Modification Model provide optimal conditions for this neurobiological process by systematically destabilizing maladaptive biases through controlled prediction failure. Unlike unstructured adversity, which degrades neural systems, structured challenge creates the precise conditions required for synaptic strengthening, dendritic complexity, and improved stress-response calibration. Implications for leadership development practice and the emerging discipline of Clinical Leaderology are discussed. This paper advances a preempirical, mechanistic framework intended to inform leadership development research and practice, rather than to serve as a validated intervention protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过结构化挑战实现功能补偿作为领导力发展的神经生物学机制，认为适当校准的认知和情感需求能促进前额叶皮质的神经可塑性，而结构化逆境在合格实践者指导下能产生可测量的神经和行为适应。
AI.research_question: 结构化挑战如何作为神经生物学机制促进领导力发展？
AI.motivation: 当前领导力发展实践缺乏神经生物学基础，需要基于大脑可塑性原理建立更科学的领导力发展机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经可塑性理论、脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）作用机制、突触可塑性、应激反应校准理论、理性领导力框架（Reasoned Leadership framework）和3B行为修正模型。
AI.method: 理论综述与机制框架构建，综合当前神经科学研究，提出预实证的机制框架。
AI.findings: 结构化挑战（而非非结构化逆境）能创造突触强化、树突复杂性和应激反应校准改善所需的精确条件，通过受控的预测失败系统性地破坏适应不良的偏见。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于神经生物学的领导力发展机制框架，将功能补偿与结构化挑战联系起来，为临床领导学（Clinical Leaderology）这一新兴学科奠定理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导力发展实践提供了神经生物学指导原则，强调需要合格实践者校准挑战水平，避免非结构化逆境的负面影响，优化领导力发展干预设计。

title:
Governance Transition and Second-Curve Entry 
Why Governance Must Change before Growth Can
affiliations: Fan Ge Institute

detail.title:
Governance Transition and Second-Curve Entry 
Why Governance Must Change before Growth Can
detail.abstract: Firms attempting to enter a second growth curve frequently intensify managerial control rather than redesign governance. This paper argues that such efforts systematically fail because management operates within a given structural equilibrium, while second-curve entry requires a change in governance. We distinguish between operational growth within the first curve and structural growth leading toward a second curve. The former depends on managerial optimization; the latter depends on governance transition. Without upgradinggovernance—specifically decision rights, resource allocation logic, and riskdistribution—innovation efforts are structurally suppressed, regardless of managerial competence. The paper introduces a critical distinction between governance for steady-stateoptimization and governance for structural transition, and demonstrates why firms often misdiagnose governance constraints as execution failures. We argue that governance upgrade within the first curve is a necessary preconditionfor second-curve entry, and that boundary-zone innovation (Ye-Jie innovation) provides apractical mechanism for this transition.

AI.tldr: 企业试图进入第二增长曲线时，通常会加强管理控制而非重新设计治理结构。本文认为这种做法会系统性失败，因为管理在既定结构均衡内运作，而第二曲线进入需要治理变革。文章区分了第一曲线内的运营增长和通向第二曲线的结构增长，前者依赖管理优化，后者依赖治理转型。没有治理升级（决策权、资源分配逻辑和风险分布），创新努力会被结构性抑制。文章提出了稳态优化治理与结构转型治理的关键区别，并解释了为何企业常将治理约束误诊为执行失败。第一曲线内的治理升级是进入第二曲线的必要前提，边界区创新（Ye-Jie创新）为此转型提供了实践机制。
AI.research_question: 为什么企业在尝试进入第二增长曲线时，加强管理控制而非重新设计治理结构的做法会系统性失败？治理升级如何成为第二曲线进入的必要前提？
AI.motivation: 企业在寻求第二增长曲线时常常失败，尽管投入大量管理努力。现有研究多关注管理优化，但忽视了治理结构对创新和转型的根本性制约。企业常将治理约束误诊为执行失败，导致错误的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 结构均衡理论：管理在既定治理结构内运作，形成结构均衡
2. 治理转型理论：区分稳态优化治理与结构转型治理
3. 第二曲线理论：运营增长与结构增长的区别
4. 边界区创新（Ye-Jie创新）作为治理转型机制
AI.method: 理论构建与概念分析。通过逻辑推理建立治理升级与第二曲线进入之间的理论联系，提出概念框架区分不同类型增长和治理模式。
AI.findings:
1. 管理控制强化在第二曲线进入中会系统性失败
2. 运营增长依赖管理优化，结构增长依赖治理转型
3. 没有治理升级（决策权、资源分配逻辑、风险分布），创新会被结构性抑制
4. 企业常误将治理约束诊断为执行失败
5. 第一曲线内的治理升级是第二曲线进入的必要前提
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了治理升级作为第二曲线进入必要前提的理论框架
2. 区分了稳态优化治理与结构转型治理
3. 建立了运营增长与结构增长的理论区别
4. 引入边界区创新（Ye-Jie创新）作为治理转型机制的概念
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为企业识别治理约束而非执行失败提供诊断框架
2. 提供了通过边界区创新实现治理转型的实践路径
3. 指导企业在寻求第二增长曲线时优先进行治理升级而非管理强化
4. 帮助企业避免在第二曲线转型中的常见错误

title: Hotel Brand Personality in Sustainable Tourism: The Mediating Role of Market Mavens

detail.title: Hotel Brand Personality in Sustainable Tourism: The Mediating Role of Market Mavens
detail.abstract: As sustainability becomes central to tourism decision-making, hotels increasingly rely on brand personality to communicate environmental commitments and differentiate themselves. This paper examines how hotel brand personality dimensions influence consumer decision-making in sustainable tourism contexts and investigates the mediating role of market mavens. Drawing on brand personality theory and market maven literature, we argue that sincere, competent, and sophisticated brand personalities enhance consumer evaluations by strengthening information credibility and social diffusion through market mavens. By positioning market mavens as key information intermediaries, the study advances understanding of indirect influence mechanisms in sustainable hospitality marketing and offers actionable insights for hotels seeking to leverage brand personality to strengthen sustainability positioning.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨酒店品牌个性维度如何通过市场专家（market mavens）的中介作用影响消费者在可持续旅游背景下的决策，发现真诚、能力、精致三个品牌个性维度通过增强信息可信度和社交传播来提升消费者评价。
AI.research_question: 酒店品牌个性维度如何影响消费者在可持续旅游背景下的决策？市场专家在其中扮演什么中介角色？
AI.motivation: 随着可持续发展成为旅游决策的核心，酒店越来越依赖品牌个性来传达环境承诺和实现差异化。需要理解品牌个性如何通过信息中介机制影响消费者对可持续旅游的选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌个性理论（Brand Personality Theory）和市场专家文献（Market Maven Literature）。
AI.method: 基于理论框架构建研究模型，通过实证研究检验品牌个性维度（真诚、能力、精致）对消费者决策的影响，以及市场专家的中介作用。
AI.findings: 真诚、能力和精致的品牌个性维度通过市场专家的中介作用增强消费者评价。市场专家作为关键信息中介，通过提升信息可信度和促进社交传播来强化品牌可持续性定位。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将品牌个性理论与可持续旅游背景相结合；2）引入市场专家作为中介机制，深化对间接影响机制的理解；3）拓展了可持续酒店营销的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为酒店提供利用品牌个性强化可持续性定位的具体策略；2）识别市场专家作为关键信息中介的重要性；3）提供可操作的营销洞察，帮助酒店通过品牌个性传达环境承诺。

title: The Relationship between Export Perfor­mance and New Marketing Approaches in the Spanish Fashion Sector
affiliations: , Jaume I University and Universidad Politécnica de Valencia

detail.title: The Relationship between Export Perfor­mance and New Marketing Approaches in the Spanish Fashion Sector
detail.abstract: The objective of this investigation is to provide an empirical model (EMSP model of internationalization) to explain the relationship between the different variables that affect the export performance of Spanish companies in the fashion sector. To do so, we introduce new marketing approaches and consider such external (Environment) as internal (Management and Marketing Strategy) factors from Resource Based View (RBV) and dynamic capabilities perspectives by developing Structural Equation Modelling. The conclusions show a fundamental role of managers, relational marketing techniques, and the incorporation of new technologies to the marketing processes.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个国际化的EMSP模型，解释影响西班牙时尚企业出口绩效的各种变量关系，结合资源基础观和动态能力视角，通过结构方程建模分析发现管理者、关系营销技术和新技术应用对出口绩效至关重要。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素（环境、管理、营销策略）影响西班牙时尚企业的出口绩效？这些因素之间的关系如何？
AI.motivation: 需要为西班牙时尚企业提供一个实证模型来解释影响其出口绩效的各种变量关系，帮助企业更好地理解国际化的成功因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（RBV）和动态能力理论，结合新的营销方法。
AI.method: 结构方程建模（SEM），考虑外部（环境）和内部（管理、营销策略）因素。
AI.findings: 管理者、关系营销技术和将新技术融入营销过程对出口绩效具有根本性作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了国际化的EMSP实证模型，整合了资源基础观、动态能力和营销理论，为理解企业国际化绩效提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为西班牙时尚企业提供了具体的实践指导：重视管理者的作用、采用关系营销技术、将新技术融入营销过程，以提升出口绩效。

title: Marketing 5.0 and New Technologies Before and After the COVID-19 Pandemic

detail.title: Marketing 5.0 and New Technologies Before and After the COVID-19 Pandemic
detail.abstract: The concept of marketing has evolved from a first stage (marketing 1.0), based on the product, to the present scenario (marketing 5.0), characterized by the incorporation of new technologies and the implementation of digital marketing policies and online sales. A quantitative and qualitative analysis of a group of companies before and after the pandemic shows that the arrival of the virus has increased the use of the internet, mainly to overcome the difficulties caused by social distancing measures, although the effect has been temporary. However, there is still work to be done when it comes to the analysis of big data for market research purposes or to the development of other technologies like Artificial Intelligence (AI) or the Internet of Things (IoT).

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了从营销1.0到5.0的演变，并通过疫情前后企业数据分析发现：疫情暂时增加了互联网使用，但企业在大数据分析、AI和IoT等技术的应用仍有不足。
AI.research_question: 疫情如何影响企业从传统营销向数字化营销（营销5.0）的转型进程？企业在疫情后对大数据、人工智能和物联网等新技术的应用程度如何？
AI.motivation: 营销概念已从产品导向的营销1.0发展到技术驱动的营销5.0，但企业在实际应用新技术方面仍存在差距。疫情作为外部冲击，为研究企业数字化转型提供了独特机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 营销演进理论（从营销1.0到5.0）、数字化转型理论、技术采纳理论、危机应对理论。
AI.method: 采用定量和定性分析方法，对一组企业在疫情前后的情况进行对比研究，分析互联网使用和技术应用的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 疫情暂时增加了企业互联网使用，主要为了克服社交距离带来的困难；2. 企业在市场研究的大数据分析方面仍有不足；3. 人工智能和物联网等技术的开发应用仍需加强；4. 疫情的影响具有暂时性特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了营销演进理论在危机情境下的适用性；2. 揭示了外部冲击对技术采纳的暂时性影响；3. 为营销5.0理论提供了实证支持；4. 丰富了数字化转型的阶段理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业数字化转型提供参考路径；2. 指出大数据分析、AI和IoT是未来技术应用重点；3. 帮助企业认识疫情影响的暂时性，制定长期数字化战略；4. 为政策制定者支持企业数字化提供依据。

title: Green Luxury Brands: Do Consumers Care About Local vs International Brand Positioning?

detail.title: Green Luxury Brands: Do Consumers Care About Local vs International Brand Positioning?
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether consumers differentiate between local and international green luxury brands in their purchasing decisions. Drawing on consumer ethnocentrism, country-oforigin effects, and sustainable luxury literature, the study explores how brand origin influences perceived authenticity, credibility, and purchase intentions for environmentally conscious luxury products. Findings suggest that consumer responses depend on product category, cultural context, and perceived commitment to sustainability. Local green luxury brands benefit from authenticity perceptions and community connection, while international brands leverage established reputations and resource capabilities. The research provides strategic implications for luxury brand managers navigating the intersection of sustainability, globalization, and local market preferences in positioning green luxury offerings.

AI.tldr: 消费者在购买绿色奢侈品时，会根据品牌来源（本地vs国际）产生差异化反应，这种反应受到产品类别、文化背景和可持续性承诺感知的影响。
AI.research_question: 消费者在购买决策中是否会区分本地和国际绿色奢侈品牌？品牌来源如何影响消费者对环保奢侈品真实性、可信度和购买意愿的感知？
AI.motivation: 随着可持续发展成为奢侈品行业的重要趋势，品牌需要理解消费者如何在不同来源（本地vs国际）的绿色奢侈品牌之间做出选择，以制定有效的市场定位策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者民族中心主义、原产国效应、可持续奢侈品文献
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明具体研究方法，但基于研究问题推断可能采用实证研究方法（如调查、实验等）
AI.findings: 消费者反应取决于产品类别、文化背景和可持续性承诺感知。本地绿色奢侈品牌受益于真实性感知和社区联系，而国际品牌则利用其已建立的声誉和资源能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将消费者民族中心主义、原产国效应与可持续奢侈品文献相结合，深化了对品牌来源在绿色奢侈品购买决策中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为奢侈品品牌经理在可持续性、全球化和本地市场偏好的交汇处定位绿色奢侈品提供了战略启示，帮助品牌根据自身来源优势制定差异化策略。

title: Viewpoint: The Future of Online Marketing From an AI Perspective
affiliations: Independent, Applied Science Private University (ASU), De Montfort University, Qatar University and Northumbria University

detail.title: Viewpoint: The Future of Online Marketing From an AI Perspective

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was acquired or used to prepare this research.

detail.abstract: Marketing, especially in the online sphere, has witnessed meteoric rise since the introduction of social media networks. The innovative use of advertising in content feeds in social medial apps have promoted a keen industry from many industries in squeezing shortform ads to capture the attention of the end-user. While the aim of such online marketing efforts can vary between promoting brand perception or direct call-to-action pitches, the generic consumer continues to use social media platforms due to a plethora of reasons, including the algorithm that decides what content shows to the end-user on what occasion. Since the explosive introduction of ChatGPT, a universal arms race has started in exploiting Artificial Intelligence as the next frontier in technology, and one of the core benefactors is online marketing. This short piece opinionates the potential future use cases of AI in consumer marketing from a lens of social media platforms in three levels: basic predictive modeling, virtual assistants, and customizable experiences. The overarching aim of this work is to provide a broad roadmap of one of the possible scenarios of the development of AI in the realm of online marketing.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI在社交媒体营销中的三个潜在应用层级：基础预测建模、虚拟助手和可定制化体验，为AI在线营销发展提供路线图。
AI.research_question: AI在社交媒体平台上的消费者营销中有哪些潜在应用场景和发展路径？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体广告的兴起和ChatGPT引发的AI技术竞赛，使得AI成为在线营销的下一个前沿领域，需要探索其未来发展可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社交媒体营销理论和AI技术应用框架，构建三层级AI应用模型：预测建模、虚拟助手和个性化体验。
AI.method: 观点性论文，通过理论分析和未来场景推演，提出AI在社交媒体营销中的三层应用框架。
AI.findings: 识别出AI在社交媒体营销中的三个关键应用层级：1）基础预测建模用于优化广告投放；2）虚拟助手增强消费者互动；3）可定制化体验提升用户参与度。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了AI在社交媒体营销中的三层应用理论框架，为理解AI技术如何重塑在线营销提供了概念性模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销从业者提供了AI应用路线图，帮助企业规划AI技术在社交媒体营销中的实施策略和投资方向。

title: Type-Theoretic Formal Methods in AI Governance: Verification Substrates Within Authorization Frameworks

detail.title: Type-Theoretic Formal Methods in AI Governance: Verification Substrates Within Authorization Frameworks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived as influencing the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract:
Type-theoretic formal methods—including dependent types, refinement types, and proof-carrying code—are increasingly proposed as mechanisms for governing artificial intelligence systems in regulated environments. This paper clarifies a persistent category error in that discourse: the conflation of verification mechanisms with governance mechanisms.

We show that type-theoretic approaches function as verification substrates within governance frameworks, rather than constituting governance mechanisms in themselves. In decidable fragments, refinement types reduce to satisfiability-modulo-theories (SMT) constraint checking, and dependent types reduce to constraint solving; proof terms and certificates serve as replay-sufficient decision evidence. These methods therefore instantiate constraint-satisfaction techniques rather than defining an independent governance paradigm.

The paper analyzes architectural integration patterns for applying type-theoretic validation to probabilistic AI outputs, including pre-validation, post-validation prior to release or actuation, and type-directed regeneration. It further identifies governance functions that lie outside the scope of type systems alone, including policy authority, temporal binding of semantics, escalation and override, audit replay, and legal admissibility.

This work provides a substrate-neutral framework for evaluating formal methods in AI governance and clarifies the boundary between verification and authorization. It is intended to inform regulators, enterprises, and researchers assessing deterministic governance requirements for AI systems deployed under legal, regulatory, and operational constraints.

AI.tldr: 该论文澄清了AI治理中的一个常见误解：类型论方法（如依赖类型、精化类型）是治理框架内的验证机制，而非治理机制本身。论文分析了这些方法如何作为约束满足技术，并提出了将类型论验证集成到概率AI系统中的架构模式。
AI.research_question: 类型论形式方法（如依赖类型、精化类型、证明携带代码）在AI治理中扮演什么角色？它们与治理机制的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 在受监管环境中，类型论形式方法越来越多地被提议作为AI系统的治理机制。但存在一个持续的范畴错误：将验证机制与治理机制混为一谈。需要澄清这一混淆，为AI治理中的形式方法评估提供清晰的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 类型论形式方法理论（依赖类型、精化类型、证明携带代码）
2. 验证与治理的区分理论
3. 约束满足理论（SMT约束检查、约束求解）
4. AI治理框架理论
AI.method:
概念分析与理论论证方法，包括：
1. 范畴错误识别与分析
2. 类型论方法的技术特性分析（在可判定片段中，精化类型简化为SMT约束检查，依赖类型简化为约束求解）
3. 架构集成模式分析（预验证、发布前验证、类型导向再生）
4. 治理功能范围界定
AI.findings:
1. 类型论方法作为治理框架内的验证基底，而非独立的治理机制
2. 这些方法实例化约束满足技术，而非定义独立的治理范式
3. 识别了三种将类型论验证应用于概率AI输出的架构模式
4. 确定了超出类型系统范围的治理功能（政策权威、语义时间绑定、升级与覆盖、审计重放、法律可采性）
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 澄清了AI治理中验证机制与治理机制的范畴区分
2. 提出了"验证基底"的概念框架
3. 建立了评估AI治理中形式方法的基底中立框架
4. 明确了验证与授权之间的边界
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为监管机构、企业和研究人员提供了评估AI系统确定性治理要求的框架
2. 指导如何将类型论验证集成到AI治理架构中
3. 帮助识别需要额外治理功能的领域
4. 支持在法律法规和操作约束下部署AI系统的决策

title: Eco-Friendly Luxury Brand Extensions and Consumer Ethnocentrism

detail.title: Eco-Friendly Luxury Brand Extensions and Consumer Ethnocentrism
detail.abstract: Luxury brands are increasingly extending into eco-friendly product lines in response to growing sustainability pressures. While prior research has examined green luxury through moral identity, status signaling, and perceived value, limited attention has been paid to the role of consumer ethnocentrism in shaping evaluations of eco-friendly luxury brand extensions. Drawing on brand extension theory, signaling theory, social identity theory, and consumer ethnocentrism literature, this study develops a culturally grounded framework explaining how eco-friendly luxury extensions influence consumer evaluation and purchase intention. We argue that although eco-friendly extensions enhance symbolic and moral value, consumer ethnocentrism acts as a boundary condition that weakens these effects when brands are perceived as foreign. The paper contributes to luxury branding and sustainability research by integrating national identity considerations into green luxury extension strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了消费者民族中心主义如何影响对环保型奢侈品牌延伸的评价，发现虽然环保延伸能提升象征和道德价值，但当品牌被视为外国品牌时，消费者民族中心主义会削弱这些积极效应。
AI.research_question: 消费者民族中心主义如何影响消费者对环保型奢侈品牌延伸的评价和购买意愿？
AI.motivation: 奢侈品牌日益推出环保产品线以应对可持续发展压力，但现有研究主要关注道德认同、地位信号和感知价值，忽视了消费者民族中心主义在环保奢侈品牌延伸评价中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌延伸理论、信号理论、社会认同理论和消费者民族中心主义文献
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明，但基于理论框架构建了文化基础的解释框架
AI.findings: 虽然环保型奢侈品牌延伸能增强象征价值和道德价值，但消费者民族中心主义作为一个边界条件，当品牌被视为外国品牌时会削弱这些积极效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将国家认同考量整合到绿色奢侈品牌延伸策略中，为奢侈品牌和可持续发展研究做出贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 为奢侈品牌在制定环保延伸策略时需要考虑消费者民族中心主义的影响，特别是在跨国市场运营时

title: Design and Development of an Intelligent E-Waste Management System Using UML Modelling
affiliations: Sinhgad Institute of Management

detail.title: Design and Development of an Intelligent E-Waste Management System Using UML Modelling
detail.abstract: The rapid and unchecked growth of information and communication technologies has resulted in a substantial increase in electronic waste (e-waste), creating serious environmental and health concerns globally. As electronic devices reach their end-of-life at an accelerating pace, the presence of hazardous materials such as lead, mercury, and cadmium in e-waste poses a critical threat to soil and water ecosystems if not handled correctly. Consequently, the effective management of e-waste has become a paramount challenge that requires a structured, transparent, and technology-driven approach to replace fragmented and informal disposal methods. This research paper presents the comprehensive design and development of an intelligent E-Waste Management System, a digital solution aimed at streamlining and digitizing the intricate processes of e-waste collection, classification, and recycling. Addressing the limitations of traditional manual methods-such as lack of traceability, inefficient logistics, and poor data management-the proposed system introduces a secure, centralized web-based platform. This platform orchestrates seamless interaction between three key stakeholders: Users, who can easily schedule waste pickups and track their request status; Collectors, who utilize digital tools to manage routes and update recycling operations in real-time; and Administrators, who oversee the entire ecosystem through advanced analytics and reporting tools. To ensure a robust and error-free development process, Unified Modelling Language (UML) diagrams were extensively employed to analyse and design the system architecture. The use of Class, Sequence, Activity, and Use Case diagrams ensured clarity in requirement specification, modularity in code structure, and future scalability of the application. A distinguishing feature of this system is the integration of AI-based image classification using TensorFlow.js. This module allows for the automated and accurate identification of electronic waste categories (e.g., monitors, mobiles, laptop) directly from user-uploaded images, significantly reducing manual categorization errors and entry time. By bridging the gap between waste generators and authorized recyclers, the system enhances operational efficiency, fosters transparency in the recycling chain, and promotes responsible disposal practices among citizens. Ultimately, this research contributes toward a sustainable environmental management framework, demonstrating how modern web technologies and artificial intelligence can be leveraged to solve critical ecological challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文设计开发了一个智能电子废物管理系统，通过基于AI图像分类的Web平台连接用户、收集者和管理员，优化电子废物收集、分类和回收流程，解决传统方法缺乏可追溯性、物流效率低下和数据管理差的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个智能电子废物管理系统，通过技术驱动的方法解决传统电子废物管理中的碎片化、非正式处置问题，并提高收集、分类和回收过程的效率和透明度？
AI.motivation: 信息和通信技术的快速增长导致电子废物大幅增加，其中含有的铅、汞、镉等有害物质对土壤和水生态系统构成严重威胁。传统的手工方法存在缺乏可追溯性、物流效率低下和数据管理差等局限性，需要一种结构化、透明且技术驱动的方法来有效管理电子废物。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于系统开发理论，采用统一建模语言（UML）进行系统架构分析和设计，包括类图、序列图、活动图和用例图，确保需求规范清晰、代码结构模块化和应用未来可扩展性。同时整合人工智能图像分类理论，使用TensorFlow.js实现自动化电子废物分类。
AI.method: 采用系统设计和开发方法，构建一个集中式Web平台，连接三个关键利益相关者：用户（安排废物收集和跟踪状态）、收集者（管理路线和实时更新回收操作）、管理员（通过高级分析和报告工具监督整个生态系统）。使用UML图进行系统架构设计，并集成基于TensorFlow.js的AI图像分类模块。
AI.findings: 成功开发了一个智能电子废物管理系统，该系统通过AI图像分类自动准确识别电子废物类别（如显示器、手机、笔记本电脑），显著减少了手动分类错误和录入时间。平台实现了废物生成者与授权回收者之间的无缝连接，提高了运营效率，增强了回收链的透明度，并促进了公民负责任的处置实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 为可持续环境管理框架提供了理论贡献，展示了现代Web技术和人工智能如何被用来解决关键生态挑战。通过系统化的UML建模方法，为类似环境管理系统开发提供了可复制的架构设计范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个实用的电子废物管理解决方案，解决了传统方法的局限性。该系统通过数字化流程提高了运营效率，减少了手动错误，增强了可追溯性，并促进了负责任的废物处置实践。为政府、企业和公民提供了一个可操作的工具，有助于实现更可持续的电子废物管理。

title: The Erosion of Silence and the Compression of Lived Time: A Conceptual Framework

detail.title: The Erosion of Silence and the Compression of Lived Time: A Conceptual Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial, professional, or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper. The author received no funding from commercial, governmental, or non-profit entities for this research. The work was conducted independently and reflects the author’s scholarly analysis and interpretations.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a conceptual and integrative theoretical work based exclusively on analysis of existing published literature. It does not involve human subjects, animal subjects, experiments, surveys, interviews, or the collection or analysis of personal or sensitive data. Therefore, ethics approval was not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or non-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
This paper advances a conceptual framework proposing that the erosion of silence-the systematic elimination of unoccupied attentional space-functions as a primary upstream variable producing temporal compression, memory thinning, moral fatigue, and existential exhaustion at both individual and collective scales. Through convergent evidence from psychology, neuroscience, philosophy, and cross-cultural traditions, the paper demonstrates that silence is not merely restorative but structurally necessary for time to function as a formative medium. When attention is perpetually occupied, the attentional gate narrows and prospective time compresses (Block & Zakay, 1997). When consolidation space disappears, memory formation fails and retrospective time thins (Dewar et al., 2012). When the default mode network remains chronically suppressed, temporal integration dissolves and identity fragments (Raichle et al., 2001). The forces driving silence erosion-algorithmic attention capture, always-on connectivity, cultural valorization of busyness, and sensory saturationare systematic, structural, and self-reinforcing, producing recognizable patterns of personal temporal exhaustion that, when widespread, diverse religious traditions have independently described as signs of an "end of time.
A critical contribution of this framework is resolving the modern novelty paradox: despite unprecedented exposure to novel content through digital platforms, individuals report temporal compression rather than the expansion predicted by established novelty research (Ornstein, 1969; Avni-Babad & Ritov, 2003). The paper demonstrates that traditional novelty studies implicitly assumed consolidation space that was universally present in pre-digital environments. By identifying silence as the missing mediating variable, the framework reveals that novelty expands retrospective time only when followed by consolidation space. Without silence, continuous novelty produces pseudo-novelty—high stimulus turnover with low experiential yield—explaining why algorithmically-driven feeds compress time despite constant content novelty. This theoretical integration generates falsifiable predictions, including a testable Novelty × Silence interaction effect, and repositions novelty as a dependent variable requiring silence to realize its temporal expansion potential. The framework's primary theoretical contributions include: (1) identifying silence as an integrative construct unifying fragmented literatures on attention, memory, time perception, and contemplative practice; (2) providing the first mechanistic account of how systemic environmental changes (technological, cultural, structural) translate into subjective temporal compression; (3) theorizing temporal inequality—the stratification of lived time quality by socioeconomic status as silence becomes a purchasable commodity rather than universal commons—as a novel form of social inequality with significant policy implications; (4) developing a novel three-level integration model explaining functional convergence across independent religious and philosophical traditions (Islamic, Hindu, Buddhist, Ubuntu, Aboriginal, Lakota) through systematic cross-cultural mapping; (5) resolving the novelty paradox through silence as mediating variable; and (6) generating a comprehensive empirical research agenda with 22 testable hypotheses spanning experimental, longitudinal, neurocognitive, cross-cultural, and policy domains.
Given structural constraints that make large-scale systemic reform unlikely, the paper proposes a minimal individual intervention: the 60-second intentional pause—brief, regular interruptions of continuous occupation requiring no training, belief system, or institutional support. This intervention represents the minimal sufficient duration where silence becomes functionally effective while remaining universally feasible, addressing each mechanism of temporal compression while resisting commodification. The pause is positioned not as comprehensive solution but as preservation strategy—maintaining the possibility of temporal coherence when larger restorations are infeasible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个概念框架，认为"沉默侵蚀"（系统性消除未被占用的注意力空间）是导致个体和集体层面时间压缩、记忆稀薄、道德疲劳和存在性耗竭的主要上游变量。沉默不仅是恢复性的，更是时间作为形成性媒介的结构性必要条件。
AI.research_question: 沉默侵蚀如何作为主要上游变量导致个体和集体层面的时间压缩、记忆稀薄、道德疲劳和存在性耗竭？
AI.motivation: 现代社会中，尽管数字平台提供了前所未有的新颖内容接触机会，但个体却报告时间压缩而非预期的时间扩展，这一"现代新奇悖论"需要理论解释。同时，系统性环境变化（技术、文化、结构）如何转化为主观时间压缩的机制尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 沉默作为整合性概念统一注意力、记忆、时间感知和冥想实践等分散文献
2. 时间不平等理论：沉默成为可购买商品而非公共资源导致的社会不平等新形式
3. 三级整合模型解释不同宗教和哲学传统（伊斯兰教、印度教、佛教、Ubuntu、原住民、拉科塔）的功能趋同
4. 沉默作为中介变量解决新奇悖论
AI.method: 通过心理学、神经科学、哲学和跨文化传统的融合证据进行概念框架构建，包括系统性的跨文化映射分析，并提出包含22个可检验假设的实证研究议程。
AI.findings:
1. 沉默是时间作为形成性媒介的结构性必要条件
2. 沉默侵蚀（算法注意力捕获、始终在线连接、忙碌文化、感官饱和）导致时间压缩、记忆形成失败、身份碎片化
3. 新奇只有在有巩固空间时才能扩展回顾性时间，没有沉默的连续新奇产生"伪新奇"
4. 沉默成为可购买商品导致时间质量的社会经济分层
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 识别沉默作为整合性概念统一分散文献
2. 首次提供系统性环境变化转化为主观时间压缩的机制解释
3. 理论化时间不平等作为社会不平等新形式
4. 开发三级整合模型解释跨文化传统趋同
5. 通过沉默作为中介变量解决新奇悖论
6. 生成包含22个可检验假设的全面实证研究议程
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提出"60秒有意暂停"作为最小个体干预策略
2. 为政策制定者提供时间不平等的社会影响分析
3. 为技术设计提供注意力保护的建议框架
4. 为心理健康和福祉干预提供理论基础

title: HELYXON: Remote Patient Management as the 'New Normal'-Adapting Healthcare Information Systems through Change Management and Technology
affiliations: , CMR University and Bangkok University

detail.title: HELYXON: Remote Patient Management as the 'New Normal'-Adapting Healthcare Information Systems through Change Management and Technology

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract:
The healthcare sector has undergone a profound transformation due to rapid digitization, Healthcare 4.0, and the emergence of Society 5.0. 

The COVID-19 pandemic acted as a powerful catalyst in accelerating digital transformation of  the global healthcare sector leading to the rapid adoption of Remote Patient Management (RPM) as a mainstream mode of healthcare delivery.

 The contemporary technological advent through RPM inverted the perception of the healthcare sector by making the healthcare sector come to the patient rather than the patient going to the healthcare facility . This transformation has been enabled by the convergence of technologies such as the Internet of Health Things (IoHT), cloud computing, big data analytics, and immersive technologies including Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR). For sustainability of healthcare during this shift, just technology will not be adequate. The accurate combination of change management and technology together will be required to formulate the optimum strategy for HIS (Healthcare Information Systems) adaptation i.e. the internal adaptation of the HIS for external efficiency output/ external sustainability of the healthcare delivery platform that has the HIS as the backbone of delivery.

Thus,  this particular case study examines HELYXON, I.I.T. Madras Research park, a technology-enabled healthcare platform that operationalized RPM during the pandemic, ultimately establishing it as the “new normal” of healthcare practice on a global scale. The case critically explores how Healthcare Information Systems (HIS), as the backbone of healthcare delivery, requires continuous and timely adaptation to sustain remote care at scale.

During the pandemic, lockdowns and safety protocols overwhelmed the healthcare infrastructure and thus compelled healthcare professionals to remotely monitor and manage not only COVID-19 patients but also individuals with communicable and non-communicable diseases. This sudden transition exposed significant challenges related to system readiness, professional adaptation, patient acceptance, and information flow.

AI.tldr: 本文通过HELYXON案例研究，探讨了在Healthcare 4.0和Society 5.0背景下，远程患者管理(RPM)如何成为医疗保健新常态，以及医疗信息系统(HIS)如何通过技术与变革管理的结合实现持续适应以支持大规模远程护理。
AI.research_question: 医疗信息系统(HIS)作为医疗保健交付的支柱，如何通过持续及时的适应来维持大规模远程护理的可持续性？
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行加速了医疗保健数字化转型，远程患者管理(RPM)成为主流医疗交付模式。然而，仅靠技术不足以实现可持续的医疗保健，需要变革管理与技术的准确结合来制定HIS适应的最佳策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: Healthcare 4.0、Society 5.0、数字化转型理论、变革管理理论、技术适应理论、远程医疗可持续性框架
AI.method: 案例研究法，以HELYXON（I.I.T. Madras研究园区）技术驱动的医疗保健平台为研究对象，分析其在疫情期间实施RPM的实践经验。
AI.findings: 1. RPM已成为全球医疗实践的新常态；2. HIS需要持续适应以支持大规模远程护理；3. 系统准备度、专业人员适应、患者接受度和信息流是主要挑战；4. 技术与变革管理的结合对HIS适应至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了HIS适应与远程护理可持续性的理论框架；2. 深化了Healthcare 4.0和Society 5.0背景下医疗数字化转型的理解；3. 强调了变革管理与技术融合在医疗信息系统适应中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为医疗组织实施RPM提供实践指导；2. 识别了HIS适应过程中的关键挑战和解决方案；3. 展示了技术平台如何成功将RPM操作化；4. 为政策制定者和医疗管理者提供了数字化转型的战略见解。

title: The Influence of Culture on Corruption in Nigeria's Internal Security

detail.title: The Influence of Culture on Corruption in Nigeria's Internal Security

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Corruption is disreputably persistent in Nigeria despite the collection of interventions proposed to combat it. While some have blamed poverty, greed, and abysmally low salaries as the leading causes of corruption in the country, few studies have attempted to find the correlation between corruption and the Nigerian culture. Most of the existing literature on corruption in Nigeria focuses on either how it is widespread and persistent or how it impacts national development. This literature review focuses on the few studies that have attempted to find the link between culture and corruption in Nigeria. To supplement data obtained from peer-reviewed publications, other scholarly works that touch on Nigeria culture, corruption, and internal security, either as individual constructs or in correlation with other constructs, are also reviewed. The finding suggests that Nigerian culture influences corruption, which subsequently negatively affects the internal security of the country.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过文献综述探讨尼日利亚文化与腐败之间的关系，发现文化影响腐败行为，进而对国家安全产生负面影响。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚文化如何影响腐败行为，以及这种腐败如何影响国家安全？
AI.motivation: 尽管有多种干预措施，腐败在尼日利亚仍然持续存在。现有研究多关注腐败的普遍性和对发展的影响，但很少探讨文化与腐败之间的关联。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化与腐败关系的理论框架，探讨文化价值观、社会规范如何影响腐败行为，以及腐败如何影响国家安全。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，包括同行评审出版物和其他学术著作，涵盖尼日利亚文化、腐败和国家安全等主题。
AI.findings: 尼日利亚文化影响腐败行为，而腐败对国家安全产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解尼日利亚腐败问题提供了文化视角的理论框架，填补了现有文献中文化与腐败关系研究的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚反腐败政策制定提供了基于文化因素的新思路，强调需要从文化层面解决腐败问题以改善国家安全。

title: Informational Thermodynamics: The Velocity of Collapse

detail.title: Informational Thermodynamics: The Velocity of Collapse
detail.abstract: This paper develops a physics-based framework to explain why enterprise AI systems collapse at different rates across industries. Rather than treating failure as a temporal or statistical event, the study frames semantic degradation as a problem of informational thermodynamics: meaning behaves like an entropic quantity (Ω) that decays predictably under recursive transformation. Using a structural epistemic analysis of 100 peer-reviewed documents (N = 100) spanning finance, law, and medicine, the study identifies distinct semantic-entropy profiles that allow the derivation of a domain-specific drift constant (λ). The methodology models decay through a universal C₀–C₄ recursive sequence, showing that all domains traverse the same transformation stages but at different velocities. Five structural parameters—semantic density (D), decision velocity (V), interpretive tolerance (T), error asymmetry (E), and redundancy (R)—jointly determine λ and therefore collapse velocity. The findings demonstrate that industries do not differ in when collapse occurs, but in how fast semantic entropy accelerates once recursive amplification begins. High-velocity domains (e.g., finance) exhibit large λ and rapid Ω-deterioration, while redundancy-rich, slower domains (e.g., medicine) exhibit smaller λ and gradual drift accumulation. These reframing challenges governance models that treat failure as a compliance or lifecycle issue. If collapse velocity is structurally determined, then governance must operate through entropy regulation rather than temporal oversight. The study positions Enterprise Semantic Integrity (ESI) as such a regulator—capable of reducing λₑff, slowing entropy acceleration, and stabilizing Ω across recursive transformations. The result is a unified thermodynamic account that explains why enterprise AI systems degrade at different rates and why meaning-preservation mechanisms must be engineered at the structural, rather than procedural, level.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个基于物理学的框架来解释企业AI系统在不同行业中以不同速率崩溃的原因。研究将语义退化视为信息热力学问题，将意义建模为熵量(Ω)，在递归转换下可预测地衰减。通过分析金融、法律和医学领域的100份同行评审文档，研究识别了不同的语义熵分布，并推导出领域特定的漂移常数(λ)。研究发现五个结构参数共同决定λ和崩溃速度，挑战了将失败视为合规或生命周期问题的治理模型。
AI.research_question: 为什么企业AI系统在不同行业中以不同速率崩溃？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将AI系统失败视为时间或统计事件，缺乏解释不同行业崩溃速率差异的理论框架。需要从信息热力学角度理解语义退化过程，为企业AI治理提供更有效的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息热力学框架，将语义退化建模为熵量(Ω)的衰减过程。语义熵在递归转换下可预测地衰减，类似于热力学中的熵增原理。通过语义密度(D)、决策速度(V)、解释容忍度(T)、误差不对称性(E)和冗余(R)五个结构参数来解释崩溃速率的差异。
AI.method: 对金融、法律和医学领域的100份同行评审文档(N=100)进行结构认知分析。识别不同领域的语义熵分布，推导领域特定的漂移常数(λ)。使用通用的C₀–C₄递归序列模型来模拟衰减过程，分析所有领域如何经历相同的转换阶段但以不同速度进行。
AI.findings: 1. 不同行业AI系统的崩溃不是发生时间不同，而是语义熵加速的速度不同；2. 五个结构参数共同决定漂移常数λ和崩溃速度；3. 高速领域(如金融)具有较大的λ和快速的Ω恶化；4. 冗余丰富、较慢的领域(如医学)具有较小的λ和逐渐的漂移积累；5. 所有领域都经历相同的C₀–C₄递归转换阶段。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了企业AI系统崩溃的信息热力学理论框架；2. 将语义退化建模为熵量衰减过程；3. 识别了决定崩溃速度的五个关键结构参数；4. 建立了统一的C₀–C₄递归转换模型；5. 挑战了传统的基于时间或合规的失败治理模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出企业语义完整性(ESI)作为熵调节器，能够减少有效λ、减缓熵加速并稳定Ω；2. 建议治理应从时间监督转向熵调节；3. 强调意义保持机制必须在结构层面而非程序层面进行工程化；4. 为不同行业AI系统治理提供差异化策略；5. 为企业AI系统设计和维护提供实用指导。

title: International Trade Law and Economic Sovereignty: Theoretical Foundations and the Influence of NIEO/UNCTAD Frameworks

detail.title: International Trade Law and Economic Sovereignty: Theoretical Foundations and the Influence of NIEO/UNCTAD Frameworks
detail.abstract: International trade is a complex and dynamic system that enables nations to expand markets, optimize resource allocation, and access goods and services otherwise unavailable domestically. This study explores the theoretical foundations and practical applications of international trade law, emphasizing the roles of comparative advantage, policy calibration, and strategic decision-making at both corporate and governmental levels. Through empirical evidence, historical examples, and advanced analytical frameworks, the article examines how political, technological, and economic factors shape trade flows and economic outcomes. While international trade remains the primary engine of global prosperity and resource optimization, the landscape of 2026 presents an unprecedented challenge to the traditional doctrine of comparative advantage. In an era defined by geopolitical shifts and technological decoupling, the legal framework of trade is no longer just about efficiency; it is about the preservation of economic sovereignty. Moreover, it investigates the influence of initiatives such as the New International Economic Order (NIEO) and United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) policies in reinforcing economic sovereignty in developing nations. Integrating legal, economic, and strategic perspectives, this research introduces a novel mathematical representation(πd)to quantify policy depth, providing a comprehensive framework for understanding the scientific, practical, and policy-related dimensions of international trade, while ensuring economic stability, sustainable development, and the preservation of national interests (Shakibi Nejad, 2025; Prebisch & Singer, 1964; United Nations, 1974).

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨国际贸易法的理论基础与实践应用，分析比较优势、政策校准和战略决策的作用，提出政策深度量化模型(πd)，强调在2026年地缘政治和技术脱钩背景下，贸易法律框架不仅关乎效率，更涉及经济主权的维护。
AI.research_question: 在2026年地缘政治变化和技术脱钩的背景下，国际贸易法律框架如何从传统比较优势理论转向经济主权维护，以及如何量化政策深度来平衡效率与国家利益？
AI.motivation: 传统国际贸易理论强调比较优势和效率，但当前地缘政治变化和技术脱钩对传统理论构成挑战，需要重新审视贸易法律框架，使其不仅关注效率，更要维护经济主权和国家利益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较优势理论、新国际经济秩序(NIEO)理论、联合国贸易和发展会议(UNCTAD)政策框架、经济主权理论、政策深度量化理论(πd)。
AI.method: 采用实证证据、历史案例分析、先进分析框架，结合法律、经济和战略视角，引入创新的数学表示(πd)来量化政策深度。
AI.findings: 国际贸易法律框架已从单纯关注效率转向经济主权维护；发展中国家通过NIEO和UNCTAD政策强化经济主权；政策深度量化模型(πd)为理解贸易政策提供了综合框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战传统比较优势理论在当代的适用性；2. 提出经济主权在贸易法律框架中的核心地位；3. 引入政策深度量化模型(πd)作为分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供战略决策框架；2. 为政府提供政策校准工具；3. 为发展中国家提供维护经济主权的法律策略；4. 促进经济稳定和可持续发展。

title: Taxation Challenges of e-commerce Platforms in Developing Countries

detail.title: Taxation Challenges of e-commerce Platforms in Developing Countries

declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.funderStatement: I declare sole authorship of the article
